name: 伊万里温泉
sales_point: 伊万里唯一の天然温泉。施設は公共の佐賀厚生年金休暇センターで、保養・休養に好適。伊万里焼の窯元にも近く、伊万里観光の足場にも良い。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a wide variety of baths, including multiple indoor and outdoor options, and a spacious sauna. They also highlight the affordable meal and bath sets, and the ample parking.

Some reviews mention there can be unexpected extra costs for lockers.
sales_point_en: The only natural hot spring in Imari. The facility is a public welfare center, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It is also close to the Imari pottery kilns, making it a good base for sightseeing in Imari.

name: いろは島温泉
sales_point: 肥前町の南方、伊万里湾に面した温泉地。玄海国定公園いろは島の眺望が良い。「美人湯」としても人気がある。保養や海釣りの基地に最適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing Imari Bay, located south of Hizen Town. It offers great views of Iroha Island in the Genkai National Park and is popular as a 'beauty hot spring.' Ideal for relaxation and sea fishing.

name: 嬉野温泉
sales_point: 嬉野川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。温泉を利用した「温泉湯豆腐」と嬉野茶が名物。西九州観光の宿泊拠点に好適。テーマパークなどもある。
sales_point_en: Located along the clear stream of the Ureshino River, this hot spring area is famous for its 'onsen yudofu' (hot spring tofu) and Ureshino tea. It serves as a great base for sightseeing in western Kyushu and features theme parks.

name: 小城温泉
sales_point: 祇園川の清流沿いに位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、春は小城公園の桜、初夏は源氏蛍が飛び交う様を楽しめる。静かな環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated along the clear stream of the Gion River, this hot spring area is blessed with a natural environment. In spring, you can enjoy cherry blossoms at Ogi Park, and in early summer, you can see fireflies. It is a quiet place, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 唐津温泉
sales_point: 伊万里市と唐津市の中間にある北波多村に位置する温泉地。山裾の閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。風呂は明るくゆったりできる造りになっている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has a wide variety of facilities, including spacious indoor and outdoor baths, saunas, and relaxing "sleeping baths" with comfortable temperatures. They also highlight the smooth, skin-softening water quality, the reasonable prices, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the food can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: Located in Kitahata Village, between Imari City and Karatsu City, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment at the foot of the mountains, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. The baths are bright and spacious.

name: 川上峡温泉
sales_point: 佐賀市を見下ろす高台に位置する温泉地。別名「九州の嵐山」と称され、山紫水明な環境にある。春は鯉のぼり吹き流し、安芸は紅葉など四季折々の趣を楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers a fun pool with slides and wave generation, delicious meals including Saga beef aburi sushi, and relaxing hot springs.

Other reviews mention the parking can be difficult and the food can be cold.
sales_point_en: Perched on a hill overlooking Saga City, this hot spring area is also known as 'Kyushu's Arashiyama' and is surrounded by beautiful mountain scenery. In spring, you can enjoy carp streamers, and in autumn, the foliage is stunning.

name: 神埼温泉
sales_point: 城原川の清流近くに位置する温泉地。歴史のロマンあふれる吉野ヶ里遺跡探勝の基地に好適。佐賀平野が眼下に広がり、特に夜景が美しい。
review_summary:
Visitors say this hot spring offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious open-air baths with stunning mountain views, and a sauna with cold spring water. They also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the water can be cold and poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Located near the clear stream of the Jōbara River, this hot spring area is a great base for exploring the historically rich Yoshinogari ruins. The Saga Plain spreads out below, offering particularly beautiful night views.

name: 熊の川温泉
sales_point: 嘉瀬川沿いに位置する温泉地。景色の良い閑静な山峡のいで湯。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located along the Kase River, in a quiet mountain gorge with beautiful scenery. It is ideal for relaxation and recuperation in a tranquil environment and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 佐里温泉
sales_point: 松浦川沿いに位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。四季折々の花に囲まれたピラミッドを思わせる大展望浴場がシンボルとなっている。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Matsuura River, this hot spring area is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. The large open-air bath, reminiscent of a pyramid, surrounded by seasonal flowers is a symbol of the area.

name: 多久温泉
sales_point: 秀峰天山の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。多久市街地にあり、ＪＲも高速ICも近く交通の便がよい。水着で楽しむ「アクション・スパ」が併設されている。
review_summary:
People say this facility offers a variety of pools, including a flowing pool and slides, and a spacious, clean onsen with a sauna and open-air bath. They also highlight the quiet, relaxing atmosphere and the friendly, helpful staff.

Other reviews mention the admission fee can be expensive.
sales_point_en: Located at the southern foot of the magnificent Tenzan Mountain, this hot spring area is in Taku City, with convenient access to JR and expressway IC. It features an 'action spa' where you can enjoy bathing in swimsuits.

name: 武雄温泉
sales_point: 桜山の麓に位置する温泉地。1200年前の「肥前風土記」にも記述があり、歴史が永い。温泉街には朱塗りの楼門があり、武雄のシンボルとなっている。
sales_point_en: Situated at the foot of Sakurayama, this hot spring area has a long history, mentioned in the 'Hizen Fudoki' from 1200 years ago. The hot spring town features a vermilion-lacquered gate, which has become a symbol of Takeo.

name: たら竹崎温泉
location: 佐賀県 藤津郡太良町
sales_point: 有明海を目の前にした温泉地。干満の差が世界一の6メートルを誇り、「月の引力が見える町」として知られる。海の幸、山の幸が豊富で、特に新鮮な「竹崎カニ」が賞味できる。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area faces the Ariake Sea and boasts the world's largest tidal range of 6 meters, known as 'the town where you can see the moon's gravity.' It is rich in seafood and mountain delicacies, especially fresh 'Takesaki crabs.'

name: 寺浦温泉
sales_point: 玄海国定公園の仮屋湾の最奥に位置する温泉地。竹ノ子島を眼前にした風光明媚な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。海釣りも楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: Located at the innermost part of Karikawa Bay in the Genkai National Park, this hot spring area offers a picturesque environment with a view of Takenoko Island, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation. You can also enjoy sea fishing.

name: 鳥越温泉
sales_point: 新佐賀百景にも選ばれた河内湖畔に位置する温泉地。近くには市民の森、九千部山、河川プール等があり、森林浴には最適。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located by the scenic Kawachi Lake, selected as one of the new 100 scenic views of Saga. Nearby are the Citizen's Forest, Kyushinbu Mountain, and river pools, making it perfect for forest bathing.

name: 野田温泉
sales_point: 浜玉町の山あいに位置する温泉地。日帰りで入浴を楽しむ人も多い。虹の松原探勝基地に最適。
review_summary:
Diners like this onsen's delicious and affordable meals, and appreciate the continuously flowing, colorless, and odorless hot spring water. They also highlight the clean bathing facilities and the nostalgic, warm atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the bath can be small.
sales_point_en: Located in the mountains of Hamadama Town, this hot spring area is popular for day-use bathing. It serves as a great base for exploring the Rainbow Pine Grove.

name: 平谷温泉
sales_point: 本城川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。経ヶ岳や多良岳の登山基地に利用され、自炊もできる。山あいの閑静な環境で、保養・登山に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a relaxing experience with both hot and lukewarm indoor baths, and many appreciate the clean facilities. Guests also highlight the quiet, natural surroundings and ample parking, making it a peaceful escape.

Some reviews mention the outdoor bath can be cold.
sales_point_en: Situated along the gorge of the Honjo River, this hot spring area is used as a base for climbing Mount Kyogatake and Mount Tara, with self-catering options available. It is in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and hiking.

name: 古湯温泉
sales_point: 嘉瀬川の上流に位置する温泉地。雄淵雌淵等の景勝地が近く、自然環境が良い。保養・休養に好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: Located upstream of the Kase River, this hot spring area is close to scenic spots like Ouyuchi and Meibuchi, offering a good natural environment. It is ideal for relaxation and recuperation and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 外津温泉
location: 佐賀県 東松浦郡玄海町
sales_point: 外津浦の西側、外津地区に位置する温泉地。海を目前にした風光明媚な環境にある。海を眺めて体を癒し、心をほぐすことができる。静養・保養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a variety of baths, including a spacious outdoor bath with stunning ocean views, and a sauna. They also highlight the affordable entry fee, clean facilities, and delicious, reasonably priced restaurant food.

Some reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located in the Sotozu district, on the west side of Sotozuura. It offers a picturesque environment facing the sea, allowing you to relax your body and mind while enjoying the ocean view. Ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 赤川温泉(久住高原温泉郷)
sales_point: 久住山の中腹に位置する温泉地。落差十数ｍの雄飛ノ滝を望む露天風呂がある。「美人の湯」と呼ばれている。登山基地に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring features a unique, milky white sulfur spring with a strong aroma, and many highlight the outdoor baths with stunning waterfall views. They also appreciate the option to drink and take home the spring water and natural water for free. Guests mention the alternating hot and cold baths are very relaxing, and the spring water is beneficial for skin conditions.
sales_point_en: Located on the slopes of Mount Kuju, this hot spring area features an open-air bath with a view of the impressive Ouhino Falls. It is known as a 'beauty hot spring' and is ideal for mountain climbing.

name: 赤根温泉
sales_point: 国東半島北端の国見町にある歴史の永い温泉地。伊美川の上流沿いに位置し、閑静な環境にある。良質の温泉で秋は過ごしやすく、春は桜が美しい。
sales_point_en: This historic hot spring area is located in Kunimi Town at the northern tip of the Kunisaki Peninsula, along the upper reaches of the Imigawa River. It is in a quiet environment with high-quality hot springs, making it pleasant in autumn and beautiful with cherry blossoms in spring.

name: 天ヶ瀬温泉
location: 大分県 日田郡天瀬町
sales_point: 玖珠川沿いに位置する温泉地。川岸には6ヶ所の露天風呂がある。温泉パスポートで色々な温泉をはしごすることができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Kusu River, featuring six outdoor baths by the riverside. You can enjoy a variety of hot springs with a hot spring passport.

name: 生竜温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 壁湯温泉と宝泉寺温泉の中間の生竜地区に位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、静養向け。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers private baths with continuously refreshed, clean water and a choice of semi-open or indoor options. They also highlight the reasonable prices, especially on weekdays, and the generous 60-minute usage time. Guests mention the friendly and helpful staff, who provide recommendations and ensure a pleasant experience.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Shoryu district, between Kabeyu Onsen and Hosenji Onsen. It offers a quiet environment in the mountains, ideal for relaxation.

name: 筌ノ口温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 飯田高原の北端に位置する温泉地。鳴子川の渓谷に面して閑静な環境にある。近くでは乗馬を楽しむことが出来る。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a unique, iron-rich spring water that is continuously flowing, with many highlighting its distinct reddish-brown color and strong metallic scent. They also mention the water is quite hot, providing a deeply warming and refreshing experience. Guests appreciate the affordable 300 yen entrance fee and the traditional, rustic atmosphere of the facility.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northern edge of the Iida Highlands, facing the Naruko River gorge in a tranquil environment. Horseback riding is available nearby.

name: 宇佐温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ宇佐駅の南西、出光地区に位置する温泉地。宇佐神宮の東方約2キロで宇佐神宮への参拝や観光基地にも最適。
review_summary:
Reviewers describe this onsen as offering a relaxing experience with its greenish-brown sodium bicarbonate spring water, and appreciate the available amenities and friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the water can be lukewarm, and the facility can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located southwest of JR Usa Station in the Idemitsu district, about 2 kilometers east of Usa Jingu Shrine, making it a great base for visiting the shrine and sightseeing.

name: 裏耶馬渓温泉
sales_point: 裏耶馬渓、伊福の里に位置する温泉地。景観が良く深耶馬渓にも約10分ほどで行ける。耶馬渓探勝の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Ura Yabakei, in the Iifuku region. It offers beautiful scenery and is about a 10-minute drive to Deep Yabakei, making it a suitable base for exploring Yabakei.

name: 大分温泉
sales_point: 県都大分市の市街地に点在するの温泉施設の総称。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers a wide variety of delicious local dishes for breakfast, including toriten, ryukyu, and shiitake curry, as well as complimentary Yonaki Soba noodles in the evening. They also highlight the clean and spacious rooms, along with the relaxing natural hot spring baths and sauna on the top floor. Guests mention the excellent service from the staff and the hotel's convenient location near the station.
sales_point_en: A collective term for various hot spring facilities scattered throughout the city of Oita, the capital of Oita Prefecture.

name: 大神温泉
location: 大分県 速見郡日出町
sales_point: 糸ヶ浜の海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。眺望が良く、海水浴も楽しめる。風呂からの眺めは最高。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers spacious rooms with stunning ocean views and a wide variety of delicious buffet options for breakfast and dinner. They also highlight the relaxing hot spring baths, family-friendly facilities like pools and game rooms, and the excellent value for money.

Some reviews mention the food can be cold.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast of Itogahama, offering great views and the opportunity for beach activities. The view from the baths is exceptional.

name: 小野屋温泉
sales_point: 庄内町の東側に位置し、町の人々に親しまれている温泉地。お湯は茶褐色のコーラ色をしている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the eastern side of Shonai Town, well-loved by the local community. The water has a brownish color resembling cola.

name: 春日野温泉
sales_point: 駅館川河畔に位置する温泉地。大浴場、露天風呂の他、バラエティに富んだ入浴が楽しめる。また、地元でとれる海の幸を味わうことができる。
review_summary: People say this public bath offers a traditional atmosphere and high-quality, hot spring water that warms the body. They also highlight the reasonable 200 yen entry fee and the quiet, often private, bathing experience. Guests mention the helpful locals who sometimes assist with adjusting the water temperature.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located by the station canal, featuring large baths and outdoor baths, along with a variety of bathing options. You can also enjoy local seafood.

name: 壁湯温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 町田川沿いに位置する温泉地。河畔には、天然の岩をくり抜いた洞窟の露天風呂がある。素朴な雰囲気を持つ野趣満点の古湯。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn features unique cave baths and a variety of family baths, with many appreciating the delicious local cuisine for both dinner and breakfast. They also highlight the warm hospitality from the staff and the convenient public parking for day visitors.

Some reviews mention the water can be cool.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Machida River, featuring outdoor baths carved from natural rock in a cave by the riverside. It has a rustic atmosphere and is a charming old hot spring.

name: 亀川（別府温泉郷）
sales_point: 亀川駅東側の海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。別府温泉郷の一角。落ち着いた雰囲気で古風な共同浴場がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast east of Kamegawa Station, part of the Beppu Onsen area. It has a calm atmosphere and features traditional public baths.

name: 川底温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 熊本との県境に近く、町田川の上流に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれており、ホタルやカジカが生息する。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near the border with Kumamoto, upstream of the Machida River. It is blessed with a natural environment, home to fireflies and river frogs.

name: 観海寺（別府温泉郷）
sales_point: 別府温泉郷の一角。別府を代表する大型リゾートホテルが連立し、レジャーの殿堂となっている。地熱を発電や暖房に利用している。
sales_point_en: Part of the Beppu Onsen area, featuring large resort hotels that represent Beppu, making it a hub for leisure activities. Geothermal energy is utilized for power generation and heating.

name: 鉄輪（別府温泉郷）
spa_quality: 塩化物泉、酸性泉、硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 別府温泉郷の一角。一遍上人の開湯と伝えられる温泉地。多くの湯煙が立ち昇る景観は迫力満点。市営のむし湯が名物。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a unique steam bath experience with medicinal herbs, alongside traditional hot spring baths. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff who provide clear guidance on using the facilities. Guests mention the reasonable prices and the relaxing atmosphere.
spa_quality_en: Chloride Spring, Acidic Spring, Sulfate Spring
sales_point_en: Part of the Beppu Onsen area, said to be founded by the monk Ippen. The sight of numerous steam rising is impressive. The municipal steam bath is a local specialty and a national health resort.

name: 寒の地獄温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 九重山麓、標高1100メートルに位置する温泉地。摂氏13～14℃の冷泉は効能が高く、昔から冷泉療法で知られる。九重登山基地に好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers a unique experience with its extremely cold spring water and a hot sauna, which are perfect for alternating baths. They also highlight the delicious meals and the traditional, calming atmosphere of the historic building. Guests mention the staff are helpful, even assisting with car issues in snowy conditions.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 1100 meters at the foot of Mount Kuju. The cold spring at 13-14°C is highly effective and has been known for cold spring therapy for a long time. It is suitable as a base for climbing Mount Kuju.

name: 杵築温泉
sales_point: 国東半島の入口にあたる杵築藩三万二千石の城下町に位置する温泉地。気温が温暖でみかんとお茶が特産。守江湾を望み、風光明媚な環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the castle town of Kitsuki, which is the entrance to the Kunisaki Peninsula. The climate is mild, and mikan oranges and tea are local specialties. It offers a picturesque environment overlooking Muroe Bay.

name: 玖珠温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡玖珠町
sales_point: 玖珠川沿いに位置する温泉地。駅からもインターチェンジからも近く、ビジネス客の利用も多い。耶馬渓探勝の南側玄関口としても好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot springs, including a unique brown "moor" spring, and features well-designed baths with comfortable sleeping areas. Guests also highlight the clean and well-maintained facilities, including family baths and cottages with private onsen access. They appreciate the attentive staff and thoughtful touches like welcome boards and color-coded towels.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Kusu River, conveniently close to the station and interchange, making it popular among business travelers. It is also a suitable southern gateway for exploring Yabakei.

name: 佐伯温泉
sales_point: 佐伯市の中心部に位置する温泉地。佐伯湾や大入塔を望む風光明媚な環境にある。湾内でとれた魚介類は美味。夏は海水浴で賑わいを見せる。
review_summary:
People say this bathing facility is clean and well-maintained, offers a wide variety of saunas, and is conveniently located next to a roadside station with ample parking.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be cold water and the facility can be a regular bath, not a hot spring.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the center of Saiki City, offering a scenic environment overlooking Saiki Bay and Oinodake. The seafood caught in the bay is delicious, and it is lively during the summer with beach activities.

name: 七里田温泉(久住高原温泉郷)
spa_quality: 炭酸水素塩泉、硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 大船山の南東川山麓に位置する温泉地。久住高原東部の田園地帯で静かな環境にある。登山客に人気。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water, with some baths featuring a unique carbonated spring that leaves bubbles on the skin. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the availability of both indoor and outdoor baths, including a spacious open-air option. Visitors appreciate the friendly staff and the convenience of an on-site shop selling local produce.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southeastern foot of Mount Ofuneyama, in a quiet rural area in the eastern part of the Kujyu Highlands. It is popular among mountain climbers.

name: 柴石（別府温泉郷）
sales_point: 別府温泉郷の一角。男女共に温度の違う2つの内湯、露天風呂、蒸し湯がある。家族湯、滝湯も併設されている。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this public onsen offers a variety of baths, including hot and warm indoor pools, an outdoor bath, and a very hot steam bath. Visitors also highlight the affordable 300 yen entrance fee and the availability of cashless payment options. They also appreciate the friendly staff and the relaxing atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Part of the Beppu Onsen area, featuring two indoor baths with different temperatures for men and women, outdoor baths, and steam baths. Family baths and waterfall baths are also available. It is a national health resort.

name: 下毛温泉
sales_point: 安心院町の北側に位置する温泉地。観光の拠点として便利。
review_summary:
Reviewers describe this onsen as offering a relaxing experience with its greenish-brown sodium bicarbonate spring water, and appreciate the available amenities and friendly staff.

Other reviews mention the water can be lukewarm, and the facility can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the northern side of Anjuin Town, convenient as a base for sightseeing.

name: 白丹温泉(久住高原温泉郷)
sales_point: 久住高原の中にあり、北はくじゅう連山、南は阿蘇五岳から祖母、傾が望める大パノラマが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Located in the Kusumi Highlands, enjoy a grand panorama with the Kuju mountain range to the north and the Aso Five Peaks to the south.

name: 白水鉱泉温泉
sales_point: 黒岳の北東側山麓に位置する温泉地。原生林に囲まれ自然環境が良い。炭酸を含む7℃の温泉は、砂糖を入れると天然の清涼飲料になる。登山客の利用も多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northeastern foot of Mt. Kurodake, surrounded by primeval forests and excellent natural environment. The 7°C carbonated hot spring can become a natural soft drink when sugar is added, popular among climbers.

name: 深耶馬温泉
sales_point: 深耶馬渓沿いに位置する温泉地。深耶馬渓の中心、一目八景にある。自然景観が良く、深耶馬渓探勝の基地に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has clean facilities, including spotless restrooms, and offers both indoor and open-air baths with comfortable water temperatures. They also highlight the affordable entry fee, spacious parking, and a relaxing tatami mat resting area.

Other reviews mention the water can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Fukuyama River, at the center of Fukuyama Valley, known for its beautiful natural scenery, making it a great base for exploring Fukuyama Valley.

name: 陣屋温泉
sales_point: 小倉山の東方に位置する温泉地。山あいの閑静な環境にある一軒宿。芸術工房や歴史民俗資料館が併設されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located to the east of Mt. Ogura, featuring a quiet inn in a mountain setting, with an art workshop and a historical folk museum on site.

name: 筋湯温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 標高約1000メートルの高原に位置する温泉地。別名白滝温泉とも言われる。共同浴場の打たせ湯が有名。保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of about 1000 meters. Also known as Shirataki Onsen, famous for its communal bath with a waterfall shower, ideal for relaxation and therapy.

name: 長者原温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 飯田高原の中心に位置する温泉地。九重連山の登山の基地に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this tourist destination offers stunning, expansive views of the Kuju mountain range and vast wetlands with accessible wooden boardwalks for leisurely strolls. They also highlight the convenient free parking, restrooms, and nearby dining options, making it a great spot for a refreshing break. Others mention it's a popular and picturesque location for photography, especially in the early morning.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the center of Iida Highlands, suitable as a base for climbing the Kuju mountain range.

name: 杖立温泉
location: 大分県 日田郡天瀬町
sales_point: 筑後川の源流、杖立川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。熊本県境の山間にあり、小国杉に囲まれ自然環境が良い。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers a wide variety of hot springs, including two large public baths on the Oita and Kumamoto sides, and a separate "Kissho no Yu" with multiple open-air baths. They also highlight the delicious buffet-style meals with live cooking stations for dishes like steak and tempura, and the attentive staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the valley of the Tsue Tate River, at the source of the Chikugo River, surrounded by mountains near the Kumamoto border, with a great natural environment.

name: 塚野温泉
sales_point: 大分市街地の南西部、七瀬川の支流に沿いに位置する昔ながらの湯治場。山あいの閑静な環境にある。保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: A traditional hot spring area located in the southwestern part of Oita City, along a tributary of the Nanase River, in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and therapy.

name: 塚原温泉
spa_quality: 硫酸塩泉、酸性泉、硫黄泉、含鉄泉、含アルミニウム泉
sales_point: 伽藍岳の南西側中腹、標高760メートルの高所に位置する温泉地。周辺を草原に囲まれ、静かな環境にある。保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring offers a unique, highly acidic bathing experience with strong healing properties for skin conditions, and many highlight the delicious, sulfur-steamed eggs. Visitors also appreciate the option to visit the nearby volcanic crater for a small fee. They also mention the staff are friendly and helpful.
spa_quality_en: Sulfate Spring, Acidic Spring, Sulfur Spring, Iron Spring, Aluminium Spring
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 760 meters on the southwestern slope of Mt. Garandake, surrounded by grasslands in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and therapy.

name: 長湯温泉
spa_quality: 炭酸水素塩泉、二酸化炭素泉
sales_point: 芹川沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、保養・療養に好適。湯は世界有数の炭酸含有量を誇る。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the mountains along the Serikawa River, blessed with a rich natural environment, ideal for relaxation and therapy, boasting one of the highest carbon dioxide contents in the world.

name: 西谷温泉
sales_point: 本耶馬渓町の南部を流れる西谷川沿いに位置する温泉地。宿泊はログハウスで、子供も楽しめるローラースライダーもあり、家族連れで充分楽しめる内容になっている。羅漢寺耶馬渓探勝基地としても最適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Nishitani River in the southern part of Hon-Yabakei Town, featuring log cabin accommodations and a roller slide for children, making it enjoyable for families. Also ideal as a base for exploring Rakanji Yabakei.

name: 浜西温泉
location: 大分県 豊後高田市
sales_point: 周防灘を望む海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。海水浴や海の幸を堪能できる。
review_summary: Visitors say this coast offers stunning sunset views, especially when low tide creates beautiful rippled tidal flats that reflect the golden light. They also highlight the spacious and convenient parking, making it easy to access. Others mention the presence of cafes and restaurants, providing options for dining and relaxation.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast overlooking Suo Nada, where you can enjoy swimming and seafood.

name: 浜脇（別府温泉郷）
sales_point: 別府温泉の南側海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。別府温泉郷の一角で、温泉保養館「ユートピア浜脇」などが整備されている。
review_summary:
People say this public bath offers two distinct baths, one with warm water and another with hot water, and is known for its simple yet practical facilities. Visitors also highlight the affordable 200 yen entry fee, long operating hours, and convenient payment options like PayPay.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be overly warm.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the southern coast of Beppu, part of the Beppu Onsen area, with facilities like the hot spring health center 'Utopia Hamawaki' available.

name: 日出温泉
location: 大分県 速見郡日出町
sales_point: 国道10号線沿いに位置する温泉地。波静かな別府湾を一望することができる。大分、別府観光拠点に好適。夏は海水浴客などで賑わう。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers private open-air baths with stunning ocean views and delicious local chicken barbecue for dinner. They also highlight the attentive staff and the relaxing, private atmosphere.

Some reviews mention access can be difficult.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along National Route 10, offering a panoramic view of the calm Beppu Bay, ideal as a base for sightseeing in Oita and Beppu. Bustling with beachgoers in summer.

name: 日田温泉
sales_point: 筑後川の支流、三隈川沿いに位置する温泉地。市街地にあり、400年の歴史がある。鵜飼いや屋形船なども楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Mikuma River, a tributary of the Chikugo River, in the city center with a history of 400 years, where you can enjoy cormorant fishing and houseboats.

name: 日田三隈川温泉
sales_point: 三隈川に囲まれた中州に位置する温泉地。平成10年12月にリニューアルオープンした施設でも、周種の入浴法ができる。また、水郷情緒漂う町らしく、鮎やな場や鵜飼いなどを楽しめる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers excellent hot spring baths, including rooftop open-air options with scenic views, and a wide variety of delicious Japanese and Western breakfast buffet items. They also highlight the attentive staff and convenient on-site parking.

Some reviews mention the service can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on an island surrounded by the Mikuma River, featuring facilities that were renovated and reopened in December 1998, offering various bathing methods. The town has a water town atmosphere, where you can enjoy ayu fishing and cormorant fishing.

name: 別府（別府温泉郷）
spa_quality: 塩化物泉、炭酸水素塩泉、硫黄泉
sales_point: 別府駅周辺から海岸沿いの繁華街に位置する大温泉地。別府温泉郷の中心で華やかな中にもクラシックな市営の砂風呂「竹瓦温泉」等もある。
review_summary:
People say this historic bathhouse offers a unique sand bath experience where staff bury guests in warm sand, and the traditional hot spring bath provides a deeply relaxing soak. Visitors also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, and the reasonable prices for both the sand bath and regular onsen.

Some reviews mention the sand bath can be lukewarm.
spa_quality_en: Chloride Spring, Bicarbonate Spring, Sulfur Spring
sales_point_en: A large hot spring area located in the bustling district along the coast from Beppu Station, the center of Beppu Onsen, featuring both vibrant and classic attractions like the municipal sand bath 'Takegawara Onsen.'

name: 宝泉寺温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 空也上人が約1000年前に開いたと伝えられる古湯。源泉も多く、湯量豊富。夜になると浴衣姿が多く見られ、情緒深い。
sales_point_en: An ancient hot spring said to have been opened by the monk Kuya about 1000 years ago, with abundant hot spring sources and a rich flow of water. In the evening, many visitors in yukata can be seen, creating a deep atmosphere.

name: 法華院温泉(久住高原温泉郷)
sales_point: 標高1303メートル、九州最高所の坊ケツルに位置する温泉地。九重連山の登山基地に好適。徒歩でしか入れない場所なので注意。
review_summary: People say this mountain lodge offers a comfortable stay with delicious and hearty meals, including tasty rice and flavorful curry. They also highlight the wonderful natural hot spring baths, which are perfect for relaxing after a hike. Guests mention the reasonable prices for both accommodation and food, and appreciate the friendly staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 1303 meters on the highest point of Kyushu, Bōketsuru, suitable as a base for climbing the Kuju mountain range. Note that it can only be accessed on foot.

name: 堀田（別府温泉郷）
sales_point: 別府温泉郷の一角。大分自動車道別府ICを降りて来ると硫気が鼻をつき、田んぼのあちこちから白い湯煙がたなびいている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers spacious indoor and outdoor baths with quality hot spring water that leaves skin smooth. They also highlight the affordable 300 yen entry fee, clean facilities, and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention there can be strict local rules.
sales_point_en: Located in the Beppu Onsen area, you can smell the sulfur as you arrive from the Oita Expressway Beppu IC, with white steam rising from rice fields.

name: 牧の元温泉
sales_point: マラソン練習コースに最適な位置にあり、実業団や学生の合宿に多く利用されている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious indoor baths with jet massage functions, a unique cold spring water bath, and a sauna. Guests also highlight the affordable 600 yen entry fee, the large tatami resting area, and the convenient location near the station.

Some reviews mention the open-air bath can be unavailable on weekdays.
sales_point_en: Ideally situated for marathon training, it is frequently used for training camps by corporate teams and students.

name: 真玉温泉
location: 大分県 豊後高田市
sales_point: 真玉川沿いに位置する温泉地。国東半島の古湯として知られ、豊富な湯量と泉質に恵まれた天然温泉。仏跡が多く、静かな環境にある。
review_summary:
Guests mention this lodging offers delicious meals, including fresh local produce, and features spacious public baths with open-air options, plus exclusive baths for overnight guests. They also highlight the exceptional hospitality and warmth of the staff, along with the great value, especially the free bath service with lunch.

Other reviews mention the sauna can be worn.
sales_point_en: An onsen area located along the Matama River, known as an ancient hot spring in the Kunisaki Peninsula, blessed with abundant hot water and quality. It is surrounded by many historical sites and offers a tranquil environment.

name: 水分温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 温泉や観光施設や大自然に恵まれた大分県の南西部に位置する温泉地。日帰り入浴、休憩、ペット連れでの宿泊が可能でペットの洗い場もある。
sales_point_en: Located in the southwestern part of Oita Prefecture, blessed with hot springs, tourist facilities, and nature. Day-use bathing, relaxation, and pet-friendly accommodations are available, including a pet washing area.

name: 明礬（別府温泉郷）
spa_quality: 硫黄泉、酸性泉、含鉄泉、含アルミニウム泉
sales_point: 別府温泉郷の一角。「湯の花小屋」から立ち上る白い噴煙が訪れる人を楽しませてくれる、山里の温泉地。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a unique experience with its distinct sulfur scent, milky white water, and the opportunity to observe the traditional "yunohana" (hot spring flower) production. They also highlight the delicious and affordable onsen-steamed eggs and puddings, along with the reasonable entry fees.

Some reviews mention there can be an overwhelming sulfur smell.
spa_quality_en: Sulfur Spring, Acidic Spring, Iron Spring, Aluminium Spring
sales_point_en: Part of the Beppu Onsen area, this mountain hot spring delights visitors with white steam rising from the 'Yunohana Koya'. It is a national health resort.

name: 廻栖野温泉
sales_point: 大分光吉ICの南西に位置する温泉地。南方に山が並び、御座ヶ岳などの登山、ハイキング基地に好適。
sales_point_en: Located southwest of Oita Koyuki IC, it is a great base for climbing and hiking in the nearby mountains.

name: 守実温泉
sales_point: 山国町の中心部に位置する温泉地。耶馬渓の西側玄関口にあたり、耶馬渓探勝の基地に好適。山国川では渓流釣りも楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: Situated in the center of Yamakuni Town, it serves as a gateway to the western side of Yabakei and is ideal for exploring the area. You can also enjoy stream fishing in the Yamakuni River.

name: 湯坪温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 筋湯の南方、約2キロの山あいに位置する温泉地。山の幸や露天風呂で昔ながらの素朴な温泉情緒を堪能できる。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers private, natural hot spring baths, including open-air options, and provides shampoo and body soap. They also highlight the exceptional value, with a 300 yen fee per adult for a private bath. Guests mention the peaceful, rustic atmosphere and the friendly, accommodating staff.
sales_point_en: Located about 2 kilometers south of Sujiyu, this hot spring area allows you to enjoy rustic hot spring charm with local mountain delicacies and open-air baths.

name: 湯ノ釣温泉
location: 大分県 日田郡天瀬町
sales_point: 玖珠川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。鮎釣りの名所として知られる。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Kusu River gorge, this hot spring area offers a quiet environment, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation. It is also known as a prime spot for sweetfish fishing.

name: 湯平温泉
sales_point: 花合野川沿いに位置する温泉地。温泉街の坂道には石畳が敷きつめられ、情緒深い。徳川時代から胃腸の名湯と伝えられる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located along the Hanagano River, the stone-paved streets of the hot spring town exude charm. It has been known since the Tokugawa period as a famous hot spring for gastrointestinal issues and is a national health resort.

name: 由布院温泉
sales_point: 由布岳をはじめ山々に囲まれた盆地に位置する温泉地。田園風景の中に旅館が点在し、素朴な雰囲気と都会的な香りが調和する。種々のイベントが開催され、若者にも人気がある。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Nestled in a basin surrounded by mountains, including Mount Yufu, this hot spring area features inns scattered throughout rural landscapes, blending rustic charm with urban flair. Various events are held, making it popular among young people. It is a national health resort.

name: 竜門温泉
location: 大分県 玖珠郡九重町
sales_point: 九重町の北部に位置する温泉地。松木川の上流、竜門ノ滝に隣接している。春は桜、夏は滝すべり・イルミネーション、秋は紅葉と四季折々の美しい自然を肌で感じることができる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this waterfall offers a powerful and beautiful natural landscape, perfect for enjoying cool breezes and refreshing air in summer. They also highlight the free parking and opportunities for water play in the river below the falls.

Some reviews mention rockfall can prohibit water entry.
sales_point_en: Located in the northern part of Kokonoe Town, adjacent to Ryumon Falls along the Matsuki River. Experience the beauty of nature through the seasons, with cherry blossoms in spring, waterfall sliding and illuminations in summer, and autumn foliage.

name: 六ケ迫温泉
sales_point: 横岩山の中腹に位置する温泉地。四方を山に囲まれ、閑静な環境にある。飲泉もでき、糖尿、胃腸、消化器諸症状に効果が高いと言われている。
sales_point_en: Situated on the slopes of Yokoiwa Mountain, this hot spring area is surrounded by mountains, providing a quiet environment. Drinking water is available, reputed to be effective for diabetes, gastrointestinal, and digestive issues.

name: 青井岳温泉
sales_point: 境川沿いに位置する温泉地。青井岳や鰐塚山などの山々に囲まれ自然環境に恵まれている。渓流釣りや山菜採りも楽しむことができる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a variety of baths, including two open-air options, a sauna, and a walking bath, all with a unique, skin-softening "torotoro" water quality. They also highlight the free massage chairs, complimentary drinks, and a wide selection of manga in the relaxation area.

Some reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Located along the Sakai River, this hot spring area is surrounded by mountains such as Aoidakeyama and Waniizuka, offering a rich natural environment. You can enjoy stream fishing and wild vegetable picking.

name: 青島温泉
sales_point: 日南海岸の青島を前にした海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。鬼の洗濯板や熱帯植物で知られる青島や、日南海岸観光の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated along the coast in front of Aoshima on the Nichinan Coast, this hot spring area is known for its unique rock formations and tropical plants, making it a great base for exploring the Nichinan Coast.

name: 阿母ヶ平温泉
sales_point: 小林市南東端、岩瀬川沿いに位置する温泉地。霧島連峰を遠望でき、閑静で眺望の良い環境にある。地元でとれる山、川の幸を堪能できる。
sales_point_en: Located at the southeastern edge of Kobayashi City along the Iwase River, it offers a quiet environment with a good view of the Kirishima mountain range. You can enjoy local mountain and river delicacies.

name: 綾温泉
location: 宮崎県 東諸県郡綾町
sales_point: 綾南川沿いに位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、5～6月は蛍も見ることができる。酒風呂や薬草風呂、各種温泉を備え、照葉樹林公園を眺めながら、ゆったりとくつろぐことができる。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Ayaminagawa River, this hot spring area is blessed with a rich natural environment, where you can see fireflies in May and June. It features sake baths, herbal baths, and various hot springs, allowing you to relax while enjoying views of the evergreen forest park.

name: えびの高原温泉
sales_point: 標高1200メートルのえびの高原に位置する温泉地。春から秋は登山・キャンプ、冬はスケート等が楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers delicious meals, including a buffet with high-quality local ingredients and excellent Miyazaki beef shabu-shabu. Visitors also highlight the natural hot springs with both indoor and open-air baths, perfect for relaxing after a hike. They also appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, who provide helpful service.
sales_point_en: Located at an elevation of 1200 meters in Ebino Kogen, this hot spring area offers activities such as mountain climbing and camping in spring and summer, and skating in winter.

name: 飫肥十曜温泉
sales_point: 日南海岸国定公園の高台に位置する温泉地。日向灘を一望でき、風光明媚。日南観光や海水浴の基地にも好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers spacious, clean rooms with beautiful river views and a wide variety of delicious buffet options, including fresh seafood and Miyazaki beef. They also highlight the excellent, friendly, and attentive service from the staff, as well as the relaxing and well-maintained hot springs.

Some reviews mention the buffet food can be cold.
sales_point_en: Situated on a high ground in the Nichinan Coast National Park, this hot spring area offers a panoramic view of Hyuga-nada and is known for its scenic beauty, making it a great base for Nichinan sightseeing and beach activities.

name: 勝岡温泉
location: 宮崎県 北諸県郡三股町
sales_point: 都城ICの南方約5キロの三股町郊外に位置する温泉地。近くに野球、ソフトボール、陸上ができる総合運動公園があり、宿泊施設の整った温泉としてスポーツの合宿に最適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this family bathhouse offers clean, well-maintained private rooms with both indoor and open-air baths, providing a relaxing atmosphere. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, and appreciate the convenient online reservation system.

Other reviews mention the water quality can be poor.
sales_point_en: Located about 5 kilometers south of Miyakonojo IC in the suburbs of Mikado Town, this hot spring area is near a comprehensive sports park for baseball, softball, and athletics, making it ideal for sports training camps.

name: 北郷温泉
location: 宮崎県 南那珂郡北郷町
sales_point: 周辺を緑豊かな山々に囲まれた閑静な温泉地。昔から美人になれる美人湯ともいい伝えられている。
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area surrounded by lush green mountains. It is said to be a beauty hot spring that has been known for a long time.

name: 紀乃島温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ小林駅の南西、高千穂野山麓夷守に位置する温泉地。霊峰霧島連峰を後方に望む眺望の良い環境にある。登山、ハイキング、釣り等の基地に最適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including indoor and outdoor options, multiple saunas, and a cold plunge pool with natural spring water. They also highlight the excellent water quality, affordable entry fee, and the staff's kind service.

Some reviews mention the baths can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Located southwest of JR Kobayashi Station, this hot spring area offers a great view of the sacred Kirishima mountain range. It is ideal for activities like climbing, hiking, and fishing.

name: 京町温泉
sales_point: 霧島連峰の北西側山麓、川内川沿いに位置する温泉地。真幸盆地の中央で閑静な環境にある。霧島山の眺望が良い。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Sendai River on the northwest foothills of the Kirishima mountain range, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment at the center of the Makaki Basin, offering good views of Mount Kirishima.

name: 清武温泉
location: 宮崎県 宮崎郡清武町
sales_point: ＪＲ清武駅の南西約3キロの山あいに位置する温泉地。色とりどりの花や草木など豊かな自然の魅力にふれることができる。保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located about 3 kilometers southwest of JR Kiyotake Station, this hot spring area is surrounded by colorful flowers and rich nature, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 幸福温泉
location: 宮崎県 西諸県郡高原町
sales_point: 高原町中心部に位置する温泉地。霧島連山の登山基地に最適。静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this natural hot spring features a spacious sauna, wide cold baths with unique cascading water, and comfortable outdoor reclining chairs for relaxation. Guests also highlight the affordable 450 yen entry fee, friendly staff, and convenient accommodation options.

Some reviews mention the shower water pressure can be weak.
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located in the center of Takaharu Town and is ideal as a base for climbing the Kirishima mountain range. It offers a quiet environment, perfect for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 郷之原温泉
location: 宮崎県 南那珂郡北郷町
sales_point: 北郷温泉の北方、郷之原地区に位置する温泉地。杉木立に囲まれた緑豊かな環境。休養・静養に好適。
review_summary:
Diners like this restaurant's delicious carp and trout dishes, especially the carp sashimi and carp miso soup, which are also considered great value. Guests mention the hot spring baths are pleasant for long soaks, and the cold spring water bath is refreshing.

Other reviews mention the water can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: Located in the Gonohara area, north of Kitago Onsen, this hot spring area is surrounded by cedar trees in a lush environment, making it suitable for rest and recuperation.

name: ごかせ温泉
location: 宮崎県 西臼杵郡五ヶ瀬町
sales_point: 宮崎県北西部の山頂、緑豊かな五ヶ瀬町に位置する温泉地。お湯は乳白色でなめらかな肌ざわりで、心身ともにリラックスできる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this inn offers a unique, nostalgic atmosphere and a "beauty skin" hot spring with a smooth, thick texture. They also highlight the warm, natural service from staff and the clean, well-maintained facilities.

Other reviews mention the bathroom can be small and crowded.
sales_point_en: Situated at the summit in the northwest of Miyazaki Prefecture, this hot spring area features milky white water with a smooth texture, allowing for relaxation of both body and mind.

name: 極楽温泉
location: 宮崎県 西諸県郡高原町
sales_point: 湯之元温泉の南西0.7キロ地点に位置する温泉地。極楽鍋があることで知られている。霊峰高千穂峰の眺望が良く、登山基地にも最適。
review_summary: Guests mention this hot spring inn features a high-concentration carbonated spring, with some baths carved from a single stone, and a spacious sauna. They also highlight the delicious mountain and river cuisine, including ayu, yamame, horse meat, and wagyu, as well as the excellent value. Others also say the staff are very good and the facilities are well-maintained.
sales_point_en: Located 0.7 kilometers southwest of Yunomoto Onsen, this hot spring area is known for its Gokuraku Nabe. It offers great views of the sacred Takachiho Peak and is also ideal as a base for climbing.

name: 西都温泉
sales_point: 西都市街地東方を流れる一ツ瀬川河畔に位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has excellent quality hot spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth, with a variety of spacious indoor and outdoor baths, including a sauna. They also highlight the affordable and delicious food at the on-site restaurant, and the generous free ticket distribution days.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be neglected.
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located along the Hitotsuse River, east of Saito City. It offers a quiet environment, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 佐土原温泉
sales_point: 石崎海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。日向灘の眺望が良い。釣りや潮干狩りが楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this public bath features clean and spacious facilities, including a large bath with ocean views, a sauna, and a pool. Guests also highlight the reasonable admission fees and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the outdoor bath can be out of order.
sales_point_en: Located along the Ishizaki coast, this hot spring area offers great views of Hyuga-nada. It is perfect for fishing and clam digging.

name: 白滝温泉
location: 宮崎県 西臼杵郡日之影町
sales_point: 日之影川の上流沿いに位置する温泉地。四方を山々に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。緑豊かな中で滝の音をききながらの入浴は、日頃の疲れを洗い流してくれる。
sales_point_en: Situated along the upper reaches of the Hinokage River, this hot spring area is surrounded by mountains in a quiet environment. Bathing while listening to the sound of waterfalls in a lush setting washes away daily fatigue.

name: 白鳥温泉
sales_point: 白鳥山の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。「白鳥森林公園」の一角にあり、自然環境に恵まれている。天然蒸し風呂や露天風呂が魅力。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a unique natural steam bath, or "jigoku mushiburo," which offers a distinct and enjoyable experience. Visitors also highlight the stunning views from the outdoor baths and the reasonable 500 yen admission fee. They also mention the friendly staff and the availability of a restaurant serving delicious tsukemen.
sales_point_en: Located on the northern foothills of Shiratori Mountain, this hot spring area is part of the Shiratori Forest Park and is blessed with a natural environment. It features attractive natural steam baths and open-air baths.

name: 曽山寺温泉
sales_point: 宮崎市南部、加江田川沿いに位置する温泉地。杉木立に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。家族連れや団体客に人気。シーガイアにも近く、観光の拠点としても利用できる。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers private baths with silky, smooth, and high-quality hot spring water, along with clean and well-maintained rooms. They also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, who provide clear instructions. Visitors appreciate the reasonable prices, especially with the availability of discount tickets.
sales_point_en: Located in the southern part of Miyazaki City along the Kaeda River, this hot spring area is surrounded by cedar trees in a quiet environment. It is popular among families and groups, and is close to Seagaia, making it a good base for sightseeing.

name: 高崎温泉
sales_point: 高崎町中心部に位置する温泉地。温泉成分が豊富で効能の優れた良質の温泉として好評。施設には泡沫浴、電気浴、サウナ、露天風呂、家族風呂を完備している。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a dry sauna, electric baths, and an outdoor bath, along with six outdoor relaxation beds and chairs. Guests also appreciate the free tatami mat resting room and the convenient location near an RV park.

Other reviews mention the water can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located in the center of Takasaki Town. It is well-regarded for its rich mineral content and excellent therapeutic properties. Facilities include bubble baths, electric baths, saunas, open-air baths, and family baths.

name: 高屋温泉
sales_point: 西都市南部の山あいに位置する温泉地。静かな環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。都於郡城跡が近い。
sales_point_en: Located in the mountainous area of southern Saito City, this hot spring area offers a quiet environment, making it suitable for relaxation and recuperation. It is near the ruins of Toogun Castle.

name: 湯穴温泉
sales_point: 都城市の北西部、吉之元地区に位置する温泉地。霧島バードライン沿いにあり、霧島方面観光の拠点にも好適。
sales_point_en: Located in the northwestern part of Miyakonojō City, in the Yoshinomoto area, this hot spring area is along the Kirishima Bird Line, making it a good base for sightseeing in the Kirishima area.

name: 常盤温泉
sales_point: 山田町の南西部に位置する温泉地。春の梅、夏の蛍など、四季折々の風情を感じることができる。風光明媚で閑静な環境にあり、休養・保養に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this ryokan offers delicious, hearty meals, including Miyazaki beef shabu-shabu and sukiyaki, and features spacious rooms with private open-air baths. They also highlight the friendly staff, relaxing atmosphere, and complimentary lobby amenities like coffee and ice cream.

Some reviews mention the service can be inattentive.
sales_point_en: Situated in the southwestern part of Yamada Town, this hot spring area allows visitors to experience the seasonal beauty of plum blossoms in spring and fireflies in summer. It is in a picturesque and quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 長日川温泉
sales_point: 松山川沿いの山あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、かじかの鳴き声とせせらぎの音が楽しめる。保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: Located in the mountains along the Matsuyama River, this hot spring area offers a quiet environment where visitors can enjoy the sounds of frogs and the babbling of the stream. It is suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 野尻湖温泉
location: 宮崎県 西諸県郡野尻町
sales_point: 野尻町西部の城之下川河畔に位置する温泉地。一般客は利用できないが、建設業等の長期滞在者のみ宿泊できる。メロンやバラ、四季折々の花々が迎えてくれる。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Shiroshita River in the western part of Nojiri Town, this hot spring area is not open to the general public but is available for long-term stay guests from the construction industry. Visitors are welcomed by melons, roses, and seasonal flowers.

name: 蓮太郎温泉
location: 宮崎県 西諸県郡高原町
sales_point: 高原IC北方約3キロの岩瀬川河畔に位置する温泉地。30メートルもの巨大な人工滝が人気。歴史がある古湯で霧島の眺望が素晴らしい。
review_summary: People say this onsen features excellent hot springs, including high-concentration carbonated spring water and mineral spring water, with various baths and a sauna. They also highlight the delicious meals, especially the mineral spring water-cooked rice and breakfast, and the kind, attentive staff.
sales_point_en: Located about 3 kilometers north of Takaharu IC along the Iwase River, this hot spring area features a popular 30-meter tall artificial waterfall. It is a historic hot spring with a wonderful view of Kirishima.

name: 本城温泉
sales_point: 宮崎県の最南端に位置する温泉地。食と健康がテーマで、健康増進と心身のリフレッシュを提供している。また、美人湯としても知られる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features a wide variety of baths with smooth, thick, and warm water that leaves skin feeling soft, and also offers a sauna. Visitors also highlight the affordable 500 yen entry fee, the helpful staff, and the spacious parking.

Some reviews mention there can be no outdoor bath.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the southernmost tip of Miyazaki Prefecture. It focuses on food and health, providing health promotion and mental and physical refreshment. It is also known as a beautiful hot spring.

name: 山田温泉
sales_point: 西都市南部の山田地区に位置する温泉地。宮崎市にも近く、観光拠点にも好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring features a wide variety of facilities, including indoor and open-air baths, saunas, and two cold plunge pools. They also highlight the smooth, "torotoro" quality of the spring water, which leaves skin feeling soft. Guests mention the reasonable price of 420 yen, the clean and recently renovated facilities, and the spacious resting area with Wi-Fi.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the Yamada area in the southern part of Nishitōkyō City. It is close to Miyazaki City, making it a suitable base for tourism.

name: 湯之元温泉
location: 宮崎県 西諸県郡高原町
sales_point: 霧島山東側山麓に位置する温泉地。200年以上の歴史を持つ古湯。空気に触れると赤くなるサイダー温泉は飲泉で胃腸病や二日酔いに効果があると言われる。「湯めし」が名物で貧血に効く。
review_summary: People say this onsen features excellent hot springs, including high-concentration carbonated spring water and mineral spring water, with various baths and a sauna. They also highlight the delicious meals, especially the mineral spring water-cooked rice and breakfast, and the kind, attentive staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the foot of the eastern slopes of Mount Kirishima. It has a history of over 200 years. The cider hot spring, which turns red when exposed to air, is said to be effective for gastrointestinal diseases and hangovers. 'Yume-meshi' is a specialty known to help with anemia.

name: 吉田温泉
sales_point: 矢岳高原南側山麓の谷間に位置する温泉地。静かな環境で保養向き。矢岳高原観光基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in a valley at the southern foot of the Yadake Highlands. It is suitable for recuperation in a quiet environment and is a good base for tourism in the Yadake Highlands.

name: 赤瀬温泉
sales_point: 宇土半島の北岸に位置する温泉地。赤瀬海水浴場が近く、風光明媚な環境。同海岸の御輿来海岸は、日本の渚百選の一つに選ばれた景勝地となっている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the northern coast of the Uto Peninsula. It is close to Akase Beach and offers a picturesque environment. The nearby Mikoshikuri Beach is a scenic spot selected as one of Japan's top 100 beaches.

name: 赤水温泉
sales_point: 阿蘇五岳の西方麓に位置する温泉地。阿蘇の眺望が良い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the western foot of the Aso Five Peaks. It offers a great view of Aso.

name: 阿蘇内牧温泉
sales_point: 阿蘇山麓に位置する温泉地。岳川の清流沿いにあり、阿蘇を一望出来る。風光明媚。阿蘇観光の中心。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the foot of Mount Aso. It is along the clear stream of the Takegawa River and offers a panoramic view of Aso. The scenery is beautiful and it is the center of Aso tourism.

name: 阿蘇高森温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡高森町
sales_point: 阿蘇五岳の南側山麓に位置する温泉地。阿蘇の眺望が良い。ゴルフ場に隣接しており、大自然の中で温泉とゴルフが楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers delicious buffet-style meals with a wide variety of local specialties like Akagyu beef, and guests can take desserts and fruits back to their rooms. They also highlight the stunning views of Mount Aso from the rooms and open-air baths, and the friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the southern foot of the Aso Five Peaks. It offers a great view of Aso and is adjacent to a golf course, allowing guests to enjoy hot springs and golf in nature.

name: 天草下田温泉
sales_point: 天草下島の西海岸に位置する温泉地。雲仙天草国立公園の中心部で、天草灘を望み自然景観が美しい。天草観光の基地に最適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious and fresh seafood, including Ise ebi and abalone, and a wide variety of modern Japanese-style dishes. They also highlight the warm and attentive staff, who provide excellent service and create a welcoming atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the baths can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located on the west coast of Amakusa Shimojima. It is in the center of Unzen-Amakusa National Park, overlooking Amakusa-nada, with beautiful natural scenery. It is ideal as a base for Amakusa tourism and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 荒尾温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ荒尾駅の東方、三井グリーンランド遊園地に隣接している温泉地。ホテルヴェルテ内にあるホテル専用の温泉となっている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located east of JR Arao Station, adjacent to the Mitsui Greenland amusement park. It is a hotel-exclusive hot spring located within Hotel Verte.

name: 一勝地温泉
location: 熊本県 球磨郡球磨村
sales_point: 鹿児島県境にある球磨村の中心地に位置する温泉地。湯は美肌効果が高いと言われる。球磨川の川下りを楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the center of Kuma Village, near the Kagoshima Prefecture border. The water is said to have high beauty benefits. Guests can enjoy rafting on the Kuma River.

name: 植木温泉
location: 熊本県 鹿本郡植木町
sales_point: 合志川沿いに位置する温泉地。ゲートボール発祥地でもあり、スイカの名産地としても知られている。湯量は豊富で、肌になめらかな湯としても人気。昔は平島温泉と呼ばれていた。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along the Koshigawa River. It is known as the birthplace of gateball and is also famous for its watermelons. The abundant hot water is popular for its smooth texture on the skin. It was formerly known as Hirajima Onsen.

name: 産山温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡産山村
sales_point: 産山村の南西部、阿蘇やまなみゴルフ場に隣接した温泉地。広々とした大浴場は阿蘇の大自然の中で心身共にリフレッシュできる。
review_summary: Guests mention this onsen hotel features excellent hot springs with a smooth, "torotoro" texture and a pleasant sulfur aroma, often with "yu no hana" (mineral deposits). They also highlight the delicious and abundant meals, especially the local Akaushi beef steak and the wide variety of homemade pickles. Visitors appreciate the tranquil, nostalgic atmosphere and the attentive, friendly staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the southwestern part of Ubuyama Village, adjacent to the Aso Yamanami Golf Course. The spacious public bath allows for a refreshing experience in the great outdoors of Aso.

name: 小天温泉
sales_point: 唐人川河口の東方1.5キロの田園地帯に位置する温泉地。夏目漱石の小説「草枕」の舞台となった温泉地として知られ、当時の宿は漱石館として保存されている。島原湾を隔てて雲仙、普賢岳を遠望できる。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers spacious, beautifully renovated rooms and delicious, artfully prepared multi-course meals. They also highlight the unique, deeply warming onsen baths and the attentive, friendly staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located 1.5 kilometers east of the mouth of the Tojin River in a rural area. It is known as the hot spring featured in Natsume Sōseki's novel 'Kusamakura,' and the inn from that time is preserved as Sōseki-kan. It offers distant views of Unzen and Mount Fugendake across Shimabara Bay.

name: 扇温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南小国町
sales_point: 平成3年にオープンした新しい温泉地。満願寺温泉と小田温泉の中間に位置し、閑静な環境にある。キャンプ場が併設され、家族連れにも好評。
review_summary: People say this ryokan offers delicious local cuisine, especially horse sashimi and freshly cooked rice, and features numerous hot spring baths, including private family baths and a scenic mixed-gender outdoor bath. Guests mention the staff provides warm and attentive service, creating a relaxing atmosphere. They also highlight the complimentary in-room ice cream and a selection of shampoos.
sales_point_en: A new hot spring area that opened in 1991. It is located between Manganji Onsen and Oda Onsen in a quiet environment. It has a campsite, making it popular with families.

name: 小田温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南小国町
sales_point: 筑後川上流の小田川沿いに位置する温泉地。山里の閑静な環境にある。四季折々の美しい自然を体感できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located along the Oda River upstream of the Chikugo River. It is situated in a tranquil mountain village environment, allowing guests to experience the beautiful nature of the four seasons.

name: 御湯船温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡産山村
sales_point: 久住山の南側山麓、産山川の河畔に位置する温泉地。久住山登山やヒコダイ公園キャンプ基地としても好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the southern foot of Mount Kuju, along the banks of the Ubuyama River. It is suitable for climbing Mount Kuju and as a camping base for Hikodai Park.

name: 金桁温泉
sales_point: 宇土半島の南部に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。八代海、島原湾でとれる海の幸が人気。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring offers two types of baths with natural, free-flowing hot water, and the facility is clean and simple. Guests also highlight the affordable 300 yen admission fee, with children entering for free.

Some reviews mention the changing room can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in the southern part of the Uto Peninsula. It is in a quiet environment, suitable for recuperation and therapy. Seafood from Yatsushiro Sea and Shimabara Bay is popular.

name: 萱野温泉
location: 熊本県 下益城郡美里町
sales_point: 中央町の中心部近くに位置する温泉地。日本一石段や五家荘等への交通アクセスに便利。地元食材を使った心のこもった料理が人気。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located near the center of Chuo Town. It has convenient access to Japan's longest stone steps and Gokasou. Local dishes made with fresh ingredients are popular.

name: 菊鹿温泉
sales_point: 福岡と大分県境、菊鹿町に位置する温泉地。山あいののどかな田園地帯の中にあり、眺望の良い浴場と大衆演劇が楽しめる。ハーブ、薬草の里としても知られている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located in Kikuka Town, near the border of Fukuoka and Oita Prefectures. It is situated in a peaceful rural area in the mountains, offering a bath with a good view and the enjoyment of local theater. It is also known as a region for herbs and medicinal plants.

name: 菊池温泉
sales_point: 菊池盆地の中心に位置する温泉地。豊富な湯量を誇る。雲仙や阿蘇観光の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the center of the Kikuchi Basin, boasting a rich supply of hot water. It serves as a great base for sightseeing in Unzen and Aso.

name: 菊南温泉
sales_point: 遠くに阿蘇、眼下に熊本市街を臨む高台に位置する温泉地。行楽、保養の場として利用されている。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers spacious, clean rooms and access to both an on-site rock bath and the adjacent "Agannasse" hot spring facility. They also highlight the delicious and varied breakfast buffet, along with the friendly and attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be warm.
sales_point_en: Situated on a high ground overlooking Kumamoto City and distant Aso, this hot spring area is popular for leisure and relaxation.

name: 熊入温泉
sales_point: 山鹿市北部にある温泉地。吉田川沿いの田園地帯に位置し、閑静な環境にある。保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Yamaga City, nestled in a quiet rural setting along the Yoshida River, ideal for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 黒川（南小国温泉郷）
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南小国町
spa_quality: 硫黄泉、炭酸水素塩泉、塩化物泉、硫酸塩泉
sales_point: 筑後川上流に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、豊富な湯量を誇る。各旅館では趣向を凝らした露天風呂を開放している。入湯手形で「露天風呂めぐり」が楽しめる。国民保養温泉地。
spa_quality_en: Sulfur Spring, Bicarbonate Spring, Chloride Spring, Sulfate Spring
sales_point_en: Located upstream of the Chikugo River, this hot spring area is blessed with a rich natural environment and abundant hot water. Each ryokan offers unique outdoor baths, and visitors can enjoy a 'rotenburo meguri' experience with a bath ticket. It is a designated national health resort.

name: 合志温泉
sales_point: 合志町の北部に位置する温泉地。熊本観光にも便利。ゴルフ場も周辺に多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Koshi Town, convenient for Kumamoto sightseeing, with many golf courses nearby.

name: 四季の森温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南阿蘇村
sales_point: 阿蘇山南側山麓に位置する温泉地。近くにはグリーンピア南阿蘇、そば道場など各種施設があり、家族連れで楽しめる。登山、ハイキング基地にも好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a relaxing hot spring with soft, smooth water and stunning views of the surrounding Aso mountains from large windows. Guests also highlight the friendly and helpful staff, and the convenient, ample parking.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be small.
sales_point_en: Situated at the southern foot of Mount Aso, this hot spring area is close to various facilities like Greenpia Minami Aso and soba-making workshops, making it enjoyable for families. It is also suitable as a base for mountain climbing and hiking.

name: 七城温泉
sales_point: 町名が豪族菊池氏が築いた18外城のうち、7つがあることから由来した町に位置する温泉地。町のシンボルとなっている城郭作りの温泉が人気。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including walking baths, saunas with two temperature settings, and spacious open-air baths. Guests also highlight the affordable entry fees and the friendly, attentive staff.

Some reviews mention impolite guests can negatively impact the atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Located in a town named after the seven castles built by the powerful Kikuchi clan, this hot spring area features a castle-like onsen that has become a symbol of the town.

name: 神城温泉
location: 熊本県 球磨郡錦町
sales_point: 錦町の西端に位置する温泉地。竹林に囲まれた露天風呂と7種類の浴槽が好評。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the western edge of Nishiki Town, popular for its outdoor baths surrounded by bamboo groves and seven different types of bathtubs.

name: 地獄温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南阿蘇村
spa_quality: 酸性泉、硫黄泉(硫化水素型)
sales_point: 阿蘇五岳の南西側中腹、標高750メートルに位置する温泉地。垂玉温泉の1キロ程上流にあり、自然環境が良い。裏山では温泉地獄が見られ、天然の泥湯がある。
spa_quality_en: Acidic Spring, 硫黄泉(硫化水素型)
sales_point_en: Located at an elevation of 750 meters on the southwestern slope of the Aso Five Peaks, this hot spring area is about 1 kilometer upstream from Tarutama Onsen, offering a good natural environment. Visitors can see natural mud baths in the nearby mountains.

name: 水前寺温泉
sales_point: 水前寺公園近くに位置する温泉地。熊本市内観光の拠点に最適。
review_summary: People say this spa offers a luxurious private sauna and spa room with two large wooden baths, one hot and one cold, and a huge sauna. They also highlight the complimentary high-end amenities, including robes, towels, and luxury brand coffee and tea. Guests mention the staff are friendly, helpful, and attentive, providing excellent hospitality.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Suizenji Park, making it an ideal base for sightseeing in Kumamoto City.

name: 仙酔峡温泉
sales_point: 阿蘇五岳の中心、高岳、中岳の北側山麓に位置する温泉地。山と緑に包まれており、眺望が良い。阿蘇観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated at the northern foot of Takadake and Nakadake, the center of the Aso Five Peaks, this hot spring area is surrounded by mountains and greenery, offering great views. It is suitable as a base for Aso sightseeing.

name: 託麻温泉
sales_point: 熊本市街地を一望できる高台にある温泉地。緑に囲まれた一軒宿で閑静な環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a high ground with a panoramic view of Kumamoto City, featuring a quiet inn surrounded by greenery.

name: 岳湯温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡小国町
sales_point: 涌蓋山の北西側山麓に位置する温泉地。高温の蒸気が噴出し、地獄蒸しが名物。近くにはげの湯温泉がある。涌蓋山の登山基地に好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a variety of clean and well-maintained baths, including spacious open-air and private family baths with continuously flowing hot spring water. They also highlight the option to steam eggs and vegetables purchased on-site, which many find delicious. Visitors appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, contributing to a relaxing and enjoyable experience.
sales_point_en: Located on the northwestern slope of Mount Wakakusa, this hot spring area is known for its high-temperature steam and hell-steamed dishes. It is also a suitable base for climbing Mount Wakakusa.

name: 田の原（南小国温泉郷）
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南小国町
sales_point: 筑後川上流の田の原川沿いに位置する温泉地。300年前から湯治場として知られ歴史が永い。自然環境に恵まれ保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located along the Tanohara River upstream of the Chikugo River, this hot spring area has been known as a healing place for over 300 years, blessed with a good natural environment, ideal for recuperation and therapy. It is a designated national health resort.

name: 玉名温泉
sales_point: 繁根川沿いに位置する温泉地。歴史の古い温泉で、閑静な環境にある。東方に阿蘇連山を眺望できる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Sakanekawa River, known for its long history and quiet environment, with views of the Aso mountain range to the east.

name: 垂玉温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南阿蘇村
sales_point: 阿蘇五岳の南西側中腹、標高750メートルに位置する温泉地。谷あいにあり、自然環境が良い秘湯。滝の下の野趣に富んだ露天風呂が有名。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers excellent quality hot spring water with a pleasant sulfur scent, and features a large indoor bath, multiple outdoor baths, and a cold spring water bath. They also highlight the clean, stylish facilities and the beautiful natural scenery, including a waterfall. Guests mention the staff are friendly and helpful, and appreciate the option to drink fresh spring water.
sales_point_en: Situated at an elevation of 750 meters on the southwestern slope of the Aso Five Peaks, this hot spring area is nestled in a valley with a good natural environment. It is famous for its rustic outdoor baths located beneath a waterfall.

name: 杖立温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡小国町
sales_point: 筑後川の源流、杖立川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。大分県境の山間にあり、小国杉に囲まれ自然環境が良い。
sales_point_en: Located along the valley of the Tsue Tate River, the source of the Chikugo River, this hot spring area is surrounded by Oguni cedar trees in a mountainous area near the Oita Prefecture border.

name: 鶴木山温泉
location: 熊本県 葦北郡芦北町
sales_point: 鶴木山の山裾の海岸に位置する温泉地。八代海を望む風光明媚な地にある。鶴ヶ浜海水浴場が眼前に広がり、港からは釣り船なども出港し、天草観光の足場としても好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the coast at the foot of Tsurukiyama, offering scenic views of Yatsushiro Sea. Tsuruga Beach is right in front, and fishing boats depart from the nearby port, making it a great base for sightseeing in Amakusa.

name: 栃木温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南阿蘇村
sales_point: 阿蘇山西側山麓、白川渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。静かな山あいにあり、保養・休養に好適。南阿蘇谷は名水百選に選ばれた白川水源など、湧き水が多い。
review_summary: Guests mention this traditional Japanese inn offers spacious, clean rooms with private open-air baths and stunning views of the waterfall and surrounding nature. They also highlight the delicious and varied seasonal cuisine, including local specialties like horse sashimi and Akaushi beef, and appreciate the attentive and friendly staff.
sales_point_en: Located along the Shirakawa Valley on the western slope of Mount Aso, this hot spring area is in a quiet mountain setting, ideal for recuperation and relaxation. The Minami Aso Valley is known for its abundant spring water, including the Shirakawa water source, which is selected as one of Japan's top 100 waters.

name: 西合志温泉
sales_point: 西合志町にひとつの宿泊施設がある温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area with a single accommodation facility located in Nishi Koshi Town.

name: 計石温泉
location: 熊本県 葦北郡芦北町
sales_point: うたせ船が発着する計石港と万葉の歌碑の近くに位置する温泉地。不知火海の海底から自然に湧出している珍しい温泉。地元でとれる海の幸を味わうことができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Keiseki Port, where boat rides depart, and the Manyo Poetry Monument. This unique hot spring naturally springs from the seabed of the Shiranui Sea, offering local seafood delicacies.

name: はげの湯温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡小国町
sales_point: 涌蓋山北西側山麓に位置する温泉地。近くに岳湯温泉がある。涌蓋山の登山基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northwest foot of Mount Wakakusa. Close to Gaku-yu Onsen, it serves as a great base for climbing Mount Wakakusa.

name: 人吉温泉
sales_point: 球磨川沿いに位置する温泉地。豊富な湯量を誇り、共同浴場が多い。自然景観が良く球磨川下りが楽しめる。球磨焼酎と鮎が有名。
review_summary: People say this public bath offers excellent quality hot spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth, and appreciate the simple, traditional atmosphere. Visitors also highlight the affordable 300 yen entrance fee and the availability of amenities like shampoo, body soap, and lockers. They also mention the friendly and welcoming staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area along the Kumagawa River, boasting abundant hot water and many public baths. It offers beautiful natural scenery and opportunities for river rafting. Famous for Kumamoto shochu and sweetfish.

name: 日奈久温泉
sales_point: 八代市南西部の不知火海沿いに位置する温泉地。江戸初期は細川家の藩営温泉となっていた。日奈久チクワや八代海の幸が名物。
sales_point_en: Located along the Shiranui Sea in the southwestern part of Yatsushiro City, this hot spring area was a feudal hot spring for the Hosokawa clan in the early Edo period. Known for Hinagu chikuwa and local seafood.

name: 平山温泉
sales_point: 山鹿市北西端に位置する温泉地。岩村川沿いの閑静な環境にある。保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features high-quality, free-flowing hot spring water that feels smooth and makes skin soft, with many rooms offering private open-air baths. They also highlight the delicious and satisfying meals, including thoughtful touches like complimentary late-night onigiri. Guests mention the clean facilities, ample parking, and the staff's bright and polite service.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northwest edge of Yamaga City, set in a quiet environment along the Iwamura River. Ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 本渡温泉
sales_point: 有明海を望む海岸に位置する温泉地。風光明媚な環境にあり、天草観光の拠点に好適。「島原の乱」で有名な天草四郎ゆかりの地でもある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including hot and lukewarm indoor pools, a mist sauna, and a scenic open-air bath. They also highlight the reasonable prices, well-maintained facilities, and attentive staff.

Some reviews mention the service can be unprofessional.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the coast overlooking the Ariake Sea, in a picturesque environment, making it a great base for sightseeing in Amakusa. It is also known as the site related to Amakusa Shirou, famous for the Shimabara Rebellion.

name: 坊中温泉
sales_point: 阿蘇駅近くに位置する温泉地。阿蘇山観光の拠点として好適。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers indoor and outdoor baths, a sauna, and a cold plunge, with many appreciating the quality of the spring water. Visitors also highlight the very affordable 400 yen entrance fee and the clean, well-maintained facilities. They also like the tattoo-friendly policy and the convenient location near Aso Station.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located near Aso Station, serving as a suitable base for sightseeing in Aso.

name: 松島温泉
sales_point: 天草松島と天草五橋を眼前にする海岸に位置する温泉地。日本三大松島の一つで千厳山からの眺望が特に素晴らしい。天草観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the coast with views of Amakusa Matsushima and the Amakusa Gokyo Bridges. One of Japan's three great Matsushima, with particularly stunning views from Chikugen Mountain. Ideal for sightseeing in Amakusa.

name: 満願寺（南小国温泉郷）
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南小国町
sales_point: 志津川沿いに位置する温泉地。河畔から湧く温泉を石で囲った川中の野趣溢れる露天風呂が楽しめる。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Shizugawa River, featuring a rustic outdoor bath surrounded by stones, where hot springs spring from the riverbank. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 宮原温泉
location: 熊本県 鹿本郡植木町
sales_point: 植木町の北端に位置する温泉地。合志川近くの田園風景の中にあり、のどかな雰囲気がある。阿蘇の噴煙も遠望することができる。
review_summary: People say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including family baths and a large public bath, with a unique, thick spring water that leaves skin smooth and warm. They also highlight the reasonable prices for the spacious facilities and the friendly staff. Others also like the clean bathrooms and the convenient vending machines.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the northern edge of Ueki Town, set in a rural landscape near the Koushi River, offering a tranquil atmosphere. You can also see the smoke from Aso in the distance.

name: 山川温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡小国町
sales_point: 山川沿いに位置する温泉地。涌蓋山の西側山麓の杉林に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。6～7月はホタルも見ることができる。
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers delicious, beautifully presented traditional meals and features multiple private onsens with natural hot spring water. They also highlight the spotless and well-maintained facilities, along with the serene atmosphere. Visitors consistently praise the staff for their warm, attentive, and helpful service.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yamakawa River, surrounded by cedar forests at the western foot of Mount Wakakusa, in a quiet environment. Fireflies can be seen from June to July.

name: 山鹿温泉
sales_point: 山鹿市の市街地に位置する温泉地。湯量豊富で800年に及ぶ歴史を誇る。灯籠まつりが有名。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Yamaga, known for its abundant hot water and an 800-year history. Famous for its lantern festival.

name: 湯浦温泉
location: 熊本県 葦北郡芦北町
sales_point: 湯浦川沿いに位置する温泉地。奈良時代の開湯と伝えられ歴史が永い。
review_summary: People say this public bath offers a clean, modern bathing area with a single, spacious hot spring tub and free-to-use dryers. Visitors also highlight the affordable 250 yen entry fee and the kind, attentive staff. Others also mention the convenient long operating hours, with the last entry at 9:25 PM.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yupura River, said to have been established in the Nara period, boasting a long history.

name: 湯の児温泉
sales_point: 不知火海の湯の児島公園を臨む海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。太刀魚釣りや海水浴等が楽しめる。四季を通じて家族連れや観光客で賑わっている。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel offers delicious buffet meals with fresh sashimi, large fried shrimp, and a wide variety of seafood and meat dishes, along with complimentary alcoholic beverages. They also highlight the beautiful ocean views from the rooms and the spacious, relaxing hot springs. Visitors consistently praise the staff for their exceptional hospitality, attentive service, and friendly demeanor.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast facing Yunoko Park in the Shiranui Sea, offering activities like fishing for knife fish and swimming. Popular with families and tourists throughout the year.

name: 湯の谷温泉
location: 熊本県 阿蘇郡南阿蘇村
sales_point: 烏帽子岳の中腹標高800メートルの高原に位置する温泉地。遠く有明海越しに雲仙岳を眺望できる。近くに80ｍの噴気地獄がある。
review_summary: People say this onsen offers a variety of clean and well-maintained baths, including spacious open-air and private family baths with continuously flowing hot spring water. They also highlight the option to steam eggs and vegetables purchased on-site, which many find delicious. Visitors appreciate the friendly and attentive staff, contributing to a relaxing and enjoyable experience.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at an elevation of 800 meters on the slopes of Eboshidake. Offers views of Mount Unzen across the Ariake Sea. Nearby is a 80-meter geyser.

name: 湯の鶴温泉
sales_point: 水俣川上流の湯出川沿いに位置する温泉地。平家の落人伝説も残され歴史が永い。保養・休養に好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yudegawa River upstream of the Minamata River. It has a long history with legends of the Heike clan's fugitives. Designated as a national health resort, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 湯前温泉
location: 熊本県 球磨郡湯前町
sales_point: 球磨盆地をパノラマ的に見下ろせる高台に位置する温泉地。グリーンパレス公園内にあり、自然環境がよい。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers clean and well-maintained facilities, including spacious open-air baths and a wide variety of amenities. Guests also highlight the delicious and abundant meals, friendly staff, and reasonable prices.

Some reviews mention the bathing hours can be limited.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on a hill overlooking the Kumamoto Basin, within Green Palace Park, offering a good natural environment.

name: 弓ヶ浜温泉
spa_quality: 塩化物泉、炭酸水素塩泉
sales_point: 弓ヶ浜海水浴場の目前に位置する温泉地。四季を通してとれたての旬の海鮮を存分に味わえる。
review_summary: People say this inn features two types of hot springs, a unique hand-dug cave bath, and delicious, generous seafood meals. Guests also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, who provide excellent service. They also like the adorable and sociable resident cats, which often visit guest rooms.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located right in front of Yumigahama Beach, where you can enjoy fresh seasonal seafood throughout the year.

name: 湯山温泉
location: 熊本県 球磨郡水上村
sales_point: 市房高原に位置する温泉地。市房ダムの一万本の桜が美しく、自然環境が良い。市房山の登山の基地にも好適。行楽、登山シーズンには多くの家族連れで賑わう。
review_summary: Guests mention this inn offers delicious meals featuring local mountain and river ingredients, including excellent basashi and flavorful local shochu at reasonable prices. They also highlight the comfortable and clean hot spring baths, which provide a relaxing experience. Visitors appreciate the inn's quiet, natural setting and the friendly, attentive staff who create an inviting atmosphere.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Ichibu Plateau, known for its beautiful cherry blossoms with around 10,000 trees at Ichibu Dam, offering a good natural environment. It serves as a base for climbing Mount Ichibu, bustling with families during the leisure and climbing seasons.

name: 吉尾温泉
location: 熊本県 葦北郡芦北町
sales_point: 吉尾川の渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。四方を山に囲まれた閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。鮎釣りなども楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Yoshio River valley, surrounded by mountains in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. Enjoy activities like sweetfish fishing.

name: 伊川温泉
sales_point: 飯塚市の郊外に位置する温泉地。福岡市まで国道201号線でつながっており、博多観光拠点にも好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a spacious main bath with jet and electric baths, plus a popular steam sauna and rock bath. They also highlight the relaxing atmosphere, effective radon spring water, and ample parking.

Other reviews mention the service can be impolite.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the suburbs of Iizuka City. It is connected to Fukuoka City via National Route 201, making it a suitable base for sightseeing in Hakata.

name: 板屋温泉
sales_point: 福岡センチュリーゴルフ場に隣接した温泉地。水のおいしい事で知られる甘木は葛や川茸のりの産地としても有名。「あまぎ水の文化村」など見所も多い。
review_summary: People say this onsen has a unique "torotoro" (thick and smooth) water quality that leaves skin feeling soft and moisturized, with many enjoying the slightly cooler temperature for longer soaks. Visitors also highlight the charming Showa-era retro atmosphere throughout the facility, including the waiting areas and hallways. Guests mention the reasonable prices for both the public baths and private family baths, along with the friendly staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to the Fukuoka Century Golf Course. Amagi, known for its delicious water, is also famous for producing kudzu and river mushrooms. There are many attractions such as the 'Amagi Water Culture Village.'

name: 柿下温泉
location: 福岡県 田川郡香春町
sales_point: 飯岳山の西側山麓に位置する温泉地。山峡の閑静な環境にあり保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western foothills of Mt. Iidake. It is situated in a quiet mountain valley, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 片ノ瀬温泉
sales_point: 田主丸町の西端に位置する温泉地。筑後川の河畔にあり、8月～11月はフルーツ狩りや釣りが楽しめる。
review_summary:
