Guests mention this ryokan offers delicious and high-quality meals, especially the rich chicken hot pot, and a relaxing hot spring bath. They also highlight the warm and attentive staff, as well as the nostalgic Japanese-style rooms.

Other reviews mention the day-use bathing can be inconsistent.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the western edge of Tanushimaru Town. Situated by the Chikugo River, it offers fruit picking and fishing from August to November.

name: 求菩提温泉
sales_point: かつて修験道の栄えた求菩提山のふもとに位置する温泉地。山の幸料理をはじめ周辺の木工加工所等、温泉だけでなく楽しめるスポット。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mt. Kuboji, which was once a center for ascetic practices. It offers mountain delicacies and nearby woodworking workshops, making it a spot for more than just hot springs.

name: グリ－ンピア八女温泉
location: 福岡県 八女郡黒木町
sales_point: 黒木平の高原に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれた大規模年金保養基地。男岳ややさぶ岳のハイキング基地にも好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers a wide variety of facilities, including a pool, soccer field, and cottages, and appreciate the delicious and plentiful breakfast buffet. They also highlight the friendly staff, quiet atmosphere, and reasonable prices for a relaxing stay.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Kuroki Plateau. It is a large-scale pension resort blessed with a natural environment, making it suitable as a hiking base for Mt. Otake and Mt. Yasabu.

name: 玄海さつき温泉
sales_point: 悠久の歴史と文化遺産の町、玄海町に位置する温泉地。さつき松原海水浴場や玄界灘を一望でき、風光明媚な環境。湯は美肌効果が高いと言われる。夏場は海水浴客で賑わいを見せる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Genkai Town, known for its long history and cultural heritage. It offers a scenic view of Satsuki Matsubara Beach and Genkai-nada, with hot springs said to have skin-beautifying effects. It is bustling with beachgoers in summer.

name: 源じいの森温泉
location: 福岡県 田川郡赤村
sales_point: 源じいの森駅前に位置する赤村唯一の温泉地。竹林に囲まれ今川の清流のせせらぎを聞きながら、露天風呂に入ることができる。キャンプや鮎釣りも楽しめる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features spacious and clean bathing areas, including a sauna with a pleasant cypress aroma and two cold plunge pools. They also highlight the friendly staff and the large, comfortable resting area.

Some reviews mention the locker fee can be unreturned.
sales_point_en: The only hot spring area in Akama Village, located in front of Genji no Mori Station. Surrounded by bamboo groves, visitors can enjoy outdoor baths while listening to the gentle flow of the Imagawa River. Camping and sweetfish fishing are also available.

name: 篠栗温泉
location: 福岡県 糟屋郡篠栗町
sales_point: 福岡ICの東方約8キロの地点に位置する温泉地。緑あふれる自然の中でゆったりと静養できる。お湯のアルカリ度の高さは九州でも珍しいとされる。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers clean, newly filled baths, including family baths and open-air options, with some featuring saunas. Guests mention the staff are helpful and the atmosphere is quiet and relaxing, making it a pleasant place to unwind.

Other reviews mention the staff can be unprofessional.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 8 kilometers east of Fukuoka IC. It offers a relaxing environment surrounded by lush nature. The high alkalinity of the water is considered rare in Kyushu.

name: 庄内温泉
location: 福岡県 嘉穂郡庄内町
sales_point: 庄内川近くの筑豊緑地公園に隣接した温泉地。三方を山々に囲まれた自然環境の中にあり、静養・保養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area adjacent to Chikuhō Green Park near the Shonai River. Surrounded by mountains, it is ideal for relaxation and recuperation in a natural environment.

name: 筑後川温泉
sales_point: 筑後平野の東側、筑後川南側河畔に位置する温泉地。一帯が耶馬・日田・英彦山国定公園に指定され、風光明媚な自然環境に恵まれた国民保養温泉地。鵜飼い見物とフルーツ狩りが名物。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the southern bank of the Chikugo River, on the eastern side of the Chikugo Plain. The area is designated as part of the Yaba-Hita-Hikosan Quasi-National Park, blessed with scenic natural surroundings. It is famous for cormorant fishing and fruit picking.

name: 長門石温泉
sales_point: 筑後平野の中央に位置する温泉地。筑後川を望み眺望もよく、久留米観光の拠点に好適。家族行楽向きの温泉としても人気。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers excellent quality natural hot spring water with a subtle sulfur scent, and many appreciate the private family baths, some with slides for children. Guests also highlight the reasonable prices, clean facilities, and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the showers can be weak.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the center of the Chikugo Plain. It offers good views overlooking the Chikugo River and is suitable as a base for sightseeing in Kurume. It is also popular as a family-friendly hot spring.

name: 博多温泉
sales_point: 県都福岡市南区に位置する温泉地。那珂川沿いにある都心の温泉、博多の奥座敷として利用されている。博多・太宰府観光の拠点に好適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious outdoor options, multiple saunas, and a cold plunge pool. Guests also highlight the relaxing atmosphere, ample relaxation spaces with books, and convenient parking with free hours.

Some reviews mention it can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the Minami Ward of Fukuoka City, the prefectural capital. It is a city center hot spring along the Naka River, used as a retreat in Hakata. It is a suitable base for sightseeing in Hakata and Dazaifu.

name: 原鶴温泉
sales_point: 筑後川沿いに位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれた宿場街で、鵜飼いが名物。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Chikugo River. It is a post town blessed with a natural environment, famous for cormorant fishing.

name: 英彦山温泉
location: 福岡県 田川郡添田町
sales_point: 霊峰英彦山の中腹に位置する温泉地。彦山川の渓谷沿いにあり、自然環境が良い。四季の変化に富み、露天風呂からの眺望は抜群。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious meals, including crispy fried yamame and flavorful red meat steak, along with clean and well-maintained rooms. They also highlight the relaxing hot spring baths, stunning starry night views, and the friendly, helpful staff.

Some reviews mention there can be few staff.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the slopes of the sacred Mt. Hikosan. It is situated along the Hikosan River valley, offering a good natural environment. The views from the outdoor baths are exceptional, with rich seasonal changes.

name: 久山温泉
location: 福岡県 糟屋郡久山町
sales_point: ＪＲ篠栗駅の北方に位置する温泉地。樹々の緑広がる美しい自然環境の中での露天風呂が楽しめる。露天風呂からの四季移ろう景色は美しく、旅の疲れもゆったりといやせる。
review_summary: People say this facility offers a unique and relaxing wood-fired sauna experience, along with spacious and clean changing rooms and bathing areas. They also highlight the healthy, vegan-friendly food options and a wide selection of organic products in the shop. Visitors appreciate the quiet, comfortable atmosphere and the beautiful views from the cafe.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located north of JR Sasaguri Station. Visitors can enjoy outdoor baths in a beautiful natural environment filled with greenery. The changing scenery from the outdoor baths is beautiful, providing a relaxing escape from travel fatigue.

name: 二日市温泉
sales_point: 天拝山の北東、筑紫野市街地に位置する温泉地。万葉集にも登場する歴史を持つ。太宰府観光の拠点に好適。日帰り施設もあり、地元の人々で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located northeast of Tenpai Mountain, in the city center of Chikushino. It has a historical background, mentioned in the Manyoshu. It is a suitable base for sightseeing in Dazaifu, with day-use facilities popular among locals.

name: 船小屋温泉
sales_point: 矢部川河畔の水郷情緒に溢れた温泉地。蛍と鮎の名所として知られている。対岸には新船小屋温泉がある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area overflowing with the charm of a water town along the Yabe River. It is known for its fireflies and sweetfish. There is a new Funagoya Onsen across the river.

name: 宝珠山温泉
location: 福岡県 朝倉郡東峰村
sales_point: 清流と緑あふれる山里に位置する温泉地。天然記念物の花々やホタルの乱舞等、自然の中でゆっくりくつろげる。また、小石原焼でも知られている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in a mountain village rich in clear streams and greenery. It offers a relaxing experience amidst nature, with natural monuments like flowers and dancing fireflies. It is also known for Koishiwara pottery.

name: 星野温泉
location: 福岡県 八女郡星野村
sales_point: 星野村南西部、鷹取山の山麓に位置する温泉地。自然環境に恵まれ、付近にはキャンプ場等が整備されている。家族行楽基地としても好評。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen offers delicious meals, including tempura and sweetfish, and features a relaxing, quiet open-air bath with smooth, skin-softening water. They also highlight the affordable prices, comfortable resting rooms, and helpful staff.

Some reviews mention the dinner can be insufficient.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foothills of Mt. Takatō in the southwestern part of Hoshino Village. It is blessed with a natural environment, with nearby campsites and is popular as a family recreation base.

name: 耳納温泉
sales_point: 久留米ICから東方約4.5キロの住宅街の中に位置する温泉地。健康回復や維持増進を図るための温泉利用型健康施設になっている。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located about 4.5 kilometers east of Kurume IC, nestled in a residential area. It serves as a health facility utilizing hot springs for recovery and maintenance of health.

name: 六ツ門温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ久留米駅と西鉄久留米駅の中間に位置する温泉地。地下数百メートルからふんだんに湧き出る天然温泉を利用して、湯だねる・くつろぐ・やすらぐ機能を備えた施設。（男性専用）
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located between JR Kurume Station and Nishitetsu Kurume Station. It utilizes natural hot springs that flow abundantly from hundreds of meters underground, providing facilities for soaking, relaxing, and rejuvenating. (Men only)

name: 宗像王丸
sales_point: 福岡エリア最大級の日帰り温泉施設がある。宗像市は、福岡市と北九州市の中間に位置し、市域の北側は玄界灘が広がる。2017年にユネスコ世界文化遺産として、「神宿る島」宗像・沖ノ島と関連遺産群が登録され、宗像大社は周辺観光として訪れたいスポット。
sales_point_en: One of the largest day-use hot spring facilities in the Fukuoka area. Munakata City is located between Fukuoka City and Kitakyushu City, with the Genkai Sea to the north. In 2017, the UNESCO World Cultural Heritage site 'Sacred Island of Munakata' was registered, making Munakata Taisha a must-visit spot for tourists.

name: 柳川温泉
sales_point: 水郷の町、柳川に位置する温泉地。ドンコ舟の川下りなどが楽しめ、水郷情緒を味わうことができる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious and plentiful meals, including a luxurious breakfast, and features clean, comfortable rooms with separated shower booths. They also highlight the excellent natural hot spring baths, which are open until late, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the sauna can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the water town of Yanagawa. Enjoy activities like riverboat rides on Donko boats and experience the charm of the water town.

name: 柳川温泉
sales_point: 三橋町の西部に位置する温泉地。宿泊、休憩施設があり、柳川観光の拠点として好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers delicious and plentiful meals, including a luxurious breakfast, and features clean, comfortable rooms with separated shower booths. They also highlight the excellent natural hot spring baths, which are open until late, and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the sauna can be small.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the western part of Mihashi Town. It has accommodation and relaxation facilities, making it a suitable base for sightseeing in Yanagawa.

name: 湯野温泉
sales_point: 福岡市の最南部に位置する温泉地。脊振山や坊主ヶ滝、花乱ノ滝、曲渕ダムなどの観光拠点に好適。山あいの静かな環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the southernmost part of Fukuoka City. It is well-suited for visiting tourist spots like Mount Seburi, Bozu Falls, Hanaran Falls, and Kyakubuchi Dam. It is situated in a quiet mountain environment.

name: 湯の坂久留米温泉
sales_point: 久留米市内中心部に位置する温泉地。久留米ICからも近く、アクセスが便利。神経病等に効果があり、保養・休養にも適している。
review_summary:
Reviewers consistently praise this onsen for its excellent quality hot spring water, noting its distinctive sulfur scent and smooth, "torotoro" texture that leaves skin feeling refreshed. Guests also highlight the powerful auto-löyly sauna and spacious family baths, appreciating the kind staff.

Other reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Kurume. It is conveniently close to Kurume IC, effective for treating nerve diseases, and suitable for recuperation and relaxation.

name: 吉井温泉
sales_point: 筑後川沿いに位置する温泉地。耶馬日田英彦山国定公園内にあり、風光明媚な自然環境に恵まれている。国民保養温泉地に指定され、保養・療養に好適。白壁土蔵の町並み、フルーツ狩り、古墳などの観光も楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Chikugo River. It is situated within the Yaba-Hita-Hikosan National Park, blessed with a picturesque natural environment. Designated as a national health resort, it is ideal for recuperation and therapy, with attractions like white-walled storehouses, fruit picking, and ancient tombs.

name: 脇田温泉
sales_point: 犬鳴山の東側山麓、犬鳴川沿いに位置する温泉地。三方を山に囲まれた閑静な環境にある。川のせせらぎを聞きながらゆっくりと静養できる。
review_summary: People say this hotel offers delicious and beautifully presented kaiseki cuisine, with many highlighting the variety of baths, including spacious outdoor rotenburo. They also mention the reasonable prices for day-use plans and the tranquil atmosphere. Guests appreciate the attentive and professional staff, noting their excellent service and helpfulness.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Inunaki River at the eastern foot of Inunaki Mountain. It is in a quiet environment surrounded by mountains, allowing for peaceful relaxation while listening to the sound of the flowing river.

name: 荒川温泉
sales_point: 五島列島の福江島西部の荒川港に位置する温泉地。付近には玉之浦、キリシタンの遺跡等の観光スポットが多い。福江島の観光基地にも好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at Arakawa Port in the western part of Fukue Island in the Goto Islands. There are many nearby tourist spots, including Tamanaura and Christian ruins, making it a suitable base for sightseeing on Fukue Island.

name: 稲佐山温泉
sales_point: 稲佐山中腹に位置する温泉地。夜景の美しいことで知られる長崎市を一望できる。長崎観光拠点に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a wide variety of baths, including carbonated, electric, and jet baths, and highlight the stunning night views from the outdoor baths. They also appreciate the free shuttle bus service from Nagasaki Station and the reasonable prices. Guests mention the spacious parking, ample resting areas, and delicious, satisfying food options.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the slopes of Inasayama. It offers a panoramic view of Nagasaki City, known for its beautiful night scenery, making it a great base for sightseeing in Nagasaki.

name: 雲仙温泉
spa_quality: 含鉄泉、酸性泉(硫化水素型)、硫黄泉
sales_point: 国立公園第1号の雲仙の中心となる温泉地。雲仙岳の南西側標高700メートルの高原に位置し、四季折々の環境が美しい。雲仙地獄巡りなどが楽しめる。国民保養温泉地。
spa_quality_en: Iron Spring, 酸性泉(硫化水素型), Sulfur Spring
sales_point_en: The central hot spring area of Unzen, Japan's first national park. Located at an elevation of 700 meters on the southwestern side of Mount Unzen, it boasts beautiful seasonal scenery. Enjoy activities like touring the Unzen Hell. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 大崎温泉
location: 長崎県 東彼杵郡川棚町
sales_point: 大崎半島の西海岸に位置する温泉地。浴場から小串浦や西海橋を一望できる。風光明媚な環境で保養・休養に好適。海水浴や釣りが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the western coast of the Osaki Peninsula. From the bathhouse, you can enjoy a view of Ogushi Bay and the Nishi-Kai Bridge. It is suitable for recuperation and relaxation in a picturesque environment, with opportunities for swimming and fishing.

name: 小浜温泉
sales_point: 雲仙岳の西側山麓の橘湾に面した温泉地。島原の乱当時に発見されたと伝えられ、歴史が永い。豊富な湯量を誇り、自然景観がよい。特に橘湾に沈む夕日が美しい。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area facing Tachibanawan on the western foot of Mount Unzen. It is said to have been discovered during the Shimabara Rebellion, boasting a long history. Known for its abundant hot water and beautiful natural scenery, especially the stunning sunsets over Tachibanawan. Designated as a national health resort.

name: 唐比温泉
sales_point: 島原半島南側の付け根、橘湾に面している温泉地。閑静な環境で自然景観が良い。保養・静養に好適。夏は海水浴客で賑わう。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the base of the southern part of the Shimabara Peninsula, facing Tachibanawan. It is in a quiet environment with beautiful natural scenery, ideal for recuperation and relaxation. It becomes lively with beachgoers in the summer.

name: 口之津白浜温泉
sales_point: 白浜と緑の松林に囲まれた海水浴場に隣接する、美しい自然環境の中にある温泉地。夏は家族連れや団体利用者で賑わう。歴史民俗資料館やイルカウォッチング等、観光施設も豊富である。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located adjacent to a beautiful beach surrounded by white sands and green pine forests. It is bustling with families and groups during the summer. There are also many tourist facilities, including a historical and folklore museum and dolphin watching.

name: 西海橋温泉
sales_point: 佐世保市南端に位置する温泉地。ハウステンボスにも近く、佐世保観光の拠点に好適。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this hotel for its spacious rooms and large, well-maintained onsen featuring ocean views. They also appreciate the helpful staff and the availability of complimentary alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks in the lobby.

Some reviews mention the buffet can be disappointing.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the southern tip of Sasebo City. It is close to Huis Ten Bosch, making it a suitable base for sightseeing in Sasebo.

name: 島原温泉
sales_point: 島原城のある城下町に位置する温泉地。風光明媚な環境にある。雲仙普賢岳、眉山を望む、飲泉ができる温泉地。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the castle town where Shimabara Castle is situated. It is in a picturesque environment, offering views of Mount Unzen and Mayuyama, with the option for drinking the hot spring water.

name: 白岳温泉
sales_point: 田の浦温泉の南東、田助港に面した海岸に位置した温泉地。海釣りなども楽しめる見晴らしの良い環境。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on the coast facing Tasuke Port, southeast of Tanoura Onsen. It offers a scenic environment where you can enjoy sea fishing.

name: 須川温泉
sales_point: 島原湾沿いに位置する温泉地。景観が良く、静かな環境にある。なめらかな泉質は、美肌効果が高いと言われる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along Shimabara Bay. It has a beautiful landscape and a quiet environment. The smooth water quality is said to have high skin-beautifying effects.

name: 千里ヶ浜温泉
sales_point: 海水浴場としても人気の千里ヶ浜に位置する温泉地。美人の湯としても知られている。夏はマリンスポーツも楽しむことができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at Senrigahama, which is also popular as a beach. Known for its beautiful skin benefits, it offers marine sports in the summer.

name: 田の浦温泉
sales_point: 平戸島の最北端の岬に位置する温泉地。田の浦海岸に面し風光明媚な環境にあり、マリンレジャーを楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring located at the northernmost cape of Hirado Island, facing Tanoura Beach in a picturesque environment, perfect for marine leisure activities.

name: 真珠の湯温泉
sales_point: 対馬の中央部、美津島町に位置する温泉地。宿から海を見渡すことができ、夜は漁り火が見える。浅茅湾観光拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located in the central part of Tsushima, in Mitzushima Town, this hot spring offers views of the sea from the accommodation, with fishing lights visible at night. It is a great base for exploring Asan Bay.

name: 時津天然温泉
location: 長崎県 西彼杵郡時津町
sales_point: 大村湾西岸の岬の高台に位置する温泉地。夕日の美しさは県下随一と言われ、素晴らしい。風光明媚な環境にある。
review_summary:
People say this onsen has soft, smooth-feeling hot spring water and a variety of baths, including a unique mist sauna and cold spring water bath. They also highlight the delicious and affordable food, especially the oden and curry, and the welcoming, retro atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the television can be loud.
sales_point_en: Situated on a high point of a cape on the west coast of Omura Bay, this hot spring is said to have the most beautiful sunsets in the prefecture, surrounded by a scenic environment.

name: 奈良尾温泉
location: 長崎県 南松浦郡新上五島町
sales_point: 奈良尾港から車で約2分と近く、五島灘を眺めながらゆったりと温泉を満喫できる環境にある。
sales_point_en: Just a 2-minute drive from Narao Port, this hot spring allows you to relax while enjoying views of the Gotō Sea.

name: ハウステンボス温泉
sales_point: 大村湾に面したハウステンボスに隣接している温泉地。ハウステンボスでたっぷり遊んだ後に、ゆっくり過ごすのに最適。
review_summary:
People say this onsen offers a variety of baths, including open-air, cypress, and nano baths, along with both dry and mist saunas. They also highlight the reasonable 800 yen entry fee, free parking, and the availability of towels for rent.

Other reviews mention the water can be lukewarm.
sales_point_en: Adjacent to Huis Ten Bosch, this hot spring is perfect for unwinding after a fun day at the theme park, facing Omura Bay.

name: 波佐見温泉
location: 長崎県 東彼杵郡波佐見町
sales_point: 波佐見川沿いに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、温泉は美肌効果が高いと言われている。また、「焼き物の里」としても知られている。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen features a high-quality, "torotoro" (slimy) hot spring that leaves skin feeling smooth and moisturized, along with a popular high-concentration carbonated bath. They also highlight the clean facilities, ample parking, and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the facility can be crowded.
sales_point_en: Located along the Hasami River, this hot spring is in a quiet environment and is said to have high skin-beautifying effects. It is also known as a 'pottery town.'

name: 花みずき温泉
sales_point: 佐世保市南西部に位置する温泉地。西海国立公園、九十九島観光の拠点に好適。夏は鹿子前海水浴場の利用者や、観光客で賑わいを見せる。
review_summary:
People say this hotel offers a wide variety of delicious buffet options for breakfast and dinner, including fresh sashimi, sushi, and French toast, with many highlighting the all-you-can-drink alcohol. Guests also appreciate the spacious rooms, free parking, and convenient location near tourist attractions.

Other reviews mention the rooms can be dated.
sales_point_en: Located in the southwestern part of Sasebo City, this hot spring is a great base for exploring Saikai National Park and the Kujukushima Islands. It attracts many visitors in the summer.

name: 原城温泉
sales_point: 島原の乱で知られる「原城跡」の海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。有明海に浮かぶ天草島や雲仙の美しい山並みが一望できる。風光明媚で閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hot spring hotel offers a wide variety of baths, including spacious indoor and open-air options, a sauna, and a jacuzzi, all with stunning ocean views. They also highlight the delicious and fresh seafood dishes, the friendly staff, and the convenient late-afternoon discount for day visitors.

Other reviews mention the futons can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along the coast of the 'Harajō Ruins,' known for the Shimabara Rebellion. It offers stunning views of Amakusa Island and the beautiful mountains of Unzen.

name: 広田温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ早岐駅の西方約1.7キロの早岐瀬戸沿いに位置する温泉地。テニス、アスレチック、ゴルフなどの施設も併設されている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring inn offers delicious kaiseki cuisine and a variety of baths, including an open-air bath with stunning mountain views. They also highlight the reasonable prices for day-use visitors and the quiet, relaxing atmosphere.

Some reviews mention the service can be unhelpful.
sales_point_en: Located about 1.7 kilometers west of JR Haiki Station along the Haiki Seto, this hot spring features facilities for tennis, athletics, and golf.

name: 福江温泉
sales_point: 福江港の西方、鬼岳に位置する温泉地。温泉の西方には犬窄の椿の巨樹や鎧瀬溶岩海岸などがあり、見所も多い。
sales_point_en: Situated west of Fukue Port, this hot spring is near Mt. Onidake, with many attractions like the giant camellia trees and the lava coast of Goro.

name: 福島温泉
sales_point: 伊万里湾に浮かぶ周囲約40キロの福島町に位置する温泉地。福島大橋を間近に見ることができる。太古の貝類や海藻などの有機物を含む湯は、効能も高く好評。
sales_point_en: Located in Fukushima Town, which is surrounded by a 40-kilometer coastline in Imari Bay, this hot spring offers views of the Fukushima Ohashi Bridge. The water contains organic materials like ancient shellfish and seaweed, known for its health benefits.

name: 松里温泉
sales_point: 橘湾沿いに位置する温泉地。海が一望でき、風光明媚な環境にある。近くの漁港でとれる海の幸は美味。
review_summary: Guests mention this hotel is new, clean, and features a natural hot spring bath that is available until 9 AM. They also highlight the complimentary breakfast, which includes freshly baked bread, local dishes like sara udon, and whale curry. Visitors appreciate the free welcome drink bar, offering various alcoholic beverages, and the attentive, friendly staff.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along Tachibanawan, offering panoramic views of the sea in a scenic environment. The fresh seafood from the nearby fishing port is delicious.

name: 湯ノ本（壱岐湯ノ本）温泉
sales_point: 壱岐島の西岸に位置する温泉地。一帯が壱岐対馬国定公園の特別地域に指定され、風光明媚な環境。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
sales_point_en: Located on the west coast of Iki Island, this hot spring is designated as a special area of the Iki-Tsushima National Park, surrounded by beautiful scenery. It is recognized as a national health resort.

name: 脇川温泉
sales_point: 平戸市街地に位置する温泉地。平戸の玄関口にあり、平戸観光には最適。
sales_point_en: Located in the city center of Hirado, this hot spring is ideal for tourists visiting Hirado.

name: あいら温泉
location: 鹿児島県 姶良郡姶良町
sales_point: 別府川沿いに位置する温泉地。のどかな田園風景の中にあり、保養・静養に好適。
review_summary: People say this family bath offers private rooms with spacious tubs where the water is changed for each guest. They also highlight the affordable price, with many mentioning it's a great value for the quality of the hot spring water. Guests appreciate the friendly staff and the convenient drive-through check-in process.
sales_point_en: Situated along the Beppu River, this hot spring is in a tranquil rural setting, perfect for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 阿久根温泉
location: 鹿児島県 阿久根市
sales_point: 阿久根市の中心部に位置し、高松川沿いにある温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located in the center of Akune City, this hot spring is along the Takamatsu River.

name: 安楽（新川渓谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 天降川上流の新川渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。新川渓谷温泉郷の一角。山あいの静かな環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located along the Shinkawa Valley upstream of the Amagoi River, in a quiet mountain environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. It is recognized as a national health resort.

name: 硫黄谷（霧島温泉郷）
sales_point: 霧島温泉郷のひとつに数えられる温泉地。硫黄谷の山腹に湧く温泉で、国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a wide variety of baths with different spring qualities, including sulfur, alum, and salt springs, and highlight the enormous main bath and spacious outdoor baths. They also mention the reasonable day-use fee includes a modesty towel and access to amenities like shampoo, conditioner, and body soap. Guests appreciate the attentive staff and the overall relaxing and enjoyable atmosphere.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is one of the Kirishima Onsen, located on the slopes of Iou Valley, recognized as a national health resort.

name: 市来温泉
location: 鹿児島県 いちき串木野市
sales_point: 吹上浜砂丘北端の市来海岸に位置する温泉地。眼前の海水浴場は遠浅で設備も良く、夏場は多くの家族連れや団体客などが訪れる。
sales_point_en: Located on Ichiki Beach at the northern end of the Buki Sand Dunes, this hot spring is near a shallow beach with good facilities, attracting many families and groups in the summer.

name: 市比野温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩川内市
sales_point: 市比野川の清流に沿いに位置する温泉地。藩主島津光久の発見から約350年の歴史を持つ。三方を山に囲まれたのどかな環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the clear stream of the Ichibino River, with a history of about 350 years since its discovery by the feudal lord Shimazu Mitsuhisa. It is situated in a tranquil environment surrounded by mountains.

name: 指宿温泉
sales_point: 薩摩半島の東南端の海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。天然の砂蒸しが有名。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the southeastern coast of the Satsuma Peninsula, famous for its natural sand baths.

name: 藺牟田温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩川内市
sales_point: 藺牟田池の南東に位置する温泉地。三方を山に囲まれ閑静な環境にある。保養・静養に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located southeast of Imuta Pond, surrounded by mountains in a quiet environment, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 入来温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩川内市
sales_point: 藺牟田池の西側に位置する温泉地。湯ノ山公園が近く、閑静な環境にある。歴史の永い湯治場で、素朴な温泉街を形成している。
review_summary:
Guests mention this onsen offers two types of hot springs with distinct qualities and temperatures, along with a mist sauna. They also highlight the affordable price, spotless facilities, and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the regulars can be territorial.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located west of Imuta Pond, near Yunoyama Park, in a peaceful setting. It has a long history as a healing spot and features a quaint hot spring town.

name: 鰻温泉
sales_point: 山川町の北部、鰻池の北東岸に位置する温泉地。集落全体が源泉地帯で、あちこちから温泉の噴気が上がっている。鰻池ではフナやウナギ釣りを楽しむことができる。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a relaxing experience with hot, clear sulfur spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the delicious steamed eggs available for purchase and the friendly, helpful staff who adjust the water temperature. Guests mention the reasonable entrance fee and the availability of free parking and lockers.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northern part of Yamakawa Town, on the northeastern shore of Unagi Pond. The entire village is a hot spring area, with steam rising from various spots. Fishing for crucian carp and eel can be enjoyed at Unagi Pond.

name: 大口温泉
sales_point: 雄大な曽木の滝の北側に位置する温泉地。十曽川の上流には白蛇の滝など何カ所も滝があり、見事。近くにエドヒガンザクラがあり、桜の季節には多くの人が訪れる。山の幸が美味。
review_summary: People say this onsen has excellent quality hot springs, with many highlighting the "beautiful skin" effect that leaves skin smooth and soft. They also appreciate the well-maintained family baths, which include a resting room with tatami mats and a TV, as well as amenities like air conditioning and a hairdryer. Guests mention the friendly staff and locals, and the reasonable prices for day use and overnight stays.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located north of the majestic Sogi Falls. There are several beautiful waterfalls upstream of the Shiso River, including the White Snake Falls. The area is popular during cherry blossom season due to the nearby Edohigan cherry trees, and the local mountain delicacies are delicious.

name: 大隅温泉
sales_point: 大隈半島を流れる肝属川沿いに位置する温泉地。近くに自然休養林に指定されている高隈渓谷がある。地元の海の幸を満喫できる。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including a strong saline hot spring, open-air bath, and sauna, leaving skin smooth. Guests also highlight the delicious meals, reasonable prices, and the staff's attentive service.

Other reviews mention there can be a lack of shampoo.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Kimotsuki River flowing through the Osumi Peninsula. Nearby is the Takakuma Valley, designated as a natural relaxation forest. You can enjoy local seafood.

name: 大村温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩川内市
sales_point: 祁答院町役場の北方、大村に位置する温泉地。山間の盆地にあり、緑に囲まれた静かな環境。湯量は豊富。ゴルフ場もすぐ近くにあり、プレー後の入浴も格別。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Omura, north of the Kedoin Town Hall. It is situated in a mountain basin surrounded by greenery, providing a quiet environment. The hot spring has abundant water supply, and a golf course is nearby, making it perfect for a soak after playing.

name: 尾之間温泉
location: 鹿児島県 熊毛郡屋久町
sales_point: 本富岳南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。眺望も良く風光明媚な環境にある。周囲の観光や奥岳へのハイキング基地としても好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring offers extremely hot, high-quality alkaline water that leaves skin feeling smooth, and it's a great way to relieve post-trekking muscle soreness. Visitors also highlight the affordable 300 yen entry fee and the friendly, welcoming atmosphere among local guests. They also mention the unique local bathing rules and the availability of cold water for temperature adjustment.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located at the foot of Mount Hontomi, offering beautiful views in a picturesque environment. It serves as a great base for surrounding sightseeing and hiking to the Okudake.

name: 海潟温泉
spa_quality: 含アルミニウム泉、硫黄泉
sales_point: 錦江湾沿いに位置する温泉地。噴煙を上げる桜島南岳が正面に見え眺望がよい。海中に源泉があり、湯量も豊富で効能も高いことから湯治客の利用も多い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along Kinko Bay, with a great view of the smoking Sakurajima South Peak in front. The hot spring source is underwater, providing abundant water and high efficacy, making it popular among hot spring visitors.

name: 鹿児島温泉
location: 鹿児島県 鹿児島市
sales_point: 県都鹿児島市の市街地に点在する温泉群の総称。市内には約200ヶ所の源泉があり、随所で温泉を見かけることができる。鹿児島観光の拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: A collective term for the hot springs scattered throughout the city of Kagoshima, the prefectural capital. There are about 200 hot spring sources in the city, making it easy to find hot springs everywhere. It is an ideal base for Kagoshima tourism.

name: 加治木温泉
location: 鹿児島県 姶良郡加治木町
sales_point: 加治木ICの南西、弥勒地区に位置する温泉地。町の北部には夏にかじかが鳴く森があり、キャンプや川遊びができる。海では釣りができ、海と山の恵まれた環境にある。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located southwest of Kagimaki IC, in the Miroku district. The northern part of the town features a forest where cicadas sing in summer, offering camping and river activities. Fishing is available at the sea, providing a rich environment of both land and sea.

name: 鹿屋大平温泉
sales_point: 鹿屋市街地に位置する温泉地。鹿屋市観光や海水浴の基地に最適。地元料理が大変おいしく、くつろげる。
review_summary:
Guests mention this hotel offers a relaxing hot spring with various baths and a spacious sauna, along with delicious, simple meals for breakfast and dinner. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the friendly, attentive staff.

Other reviews mention the atmosphere can be unwelcoming.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the city center of Kanoya. It is perfect for sightseeing in Kanoya and beach activities. The local cuisine is very delicious, providing a relaxing atmosphere.

name: 蒲生温泉
location: 鹿児島県 姶良郡蒲生町
sales_point: 前郷川沿いに位置する温泉地。近くに鹿児島湾を望む。ハイキングや川遊び、釣りなどが楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Maegawa River, with views of Kagoshima Bay nearby. Enjoy hiking, river activities, and fishing.

name: 川尻温泉
sales_point: 開聞岳東側山麓の海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。登山や観光の基地に好適。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the coast at the eastern foot of Mount Kaimon. It is suitable as a base for climbing and sightseeing.

name: 観音滝温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩郡さつま町
sales_point: 中岳の東方、観音滝公園内に位置する温泉地。公園内ではグラウンドゴルフ、キャンプ、そば打ち、ガラス工芸などを体験することができる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in Kannon Falls Park, east of Mount Nakadake. The park offers experiences such as ground golf, camping, soba making, and glass crafts.

name: 岸良温泉
location: 鹿児島県 肝属郡肝付町
sales_point: 大隅半島の東部に位置する温泉地。田園風景の広がるのどかな環境にあり、保養・静養に好適。宇宙ロケットの打上げ基地も近い。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the eastern part of the Osumi Peninsula. It is in a tranquil environment with rural scenery, ideal for relaxation and recuperation. A space launch facility for rockets is also nearby.

name: 霧島神宮温泉
sales_point: ニニギノミコトを祭った霧島神宮の門前町に位置する温泉地。霧島神宮等の観光拠点に好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: People say this shrine features a beautiful, vibrant vermilion main hall and a magnificent 800-year-old sacred tree, creating a deeply spiritual atmosphere. Visitors also highlight the well-maintained grounds and ample free parking, making it accessible for all. They appreciate the serene and refreshing air, especially in the early morning.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the town in front of Kirishima Jingu, which enshrines Ninigi no Mikoto. It is suitable as a base for sightseeing at Kirishima Jingu and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 楠川温泉
location: 鹿児島県 熊毛郡上屋久町
sales_point: 楠川港沿いに位置する温泉地。宮之浦岳山頂からの展望は素晴らしく、登山客で賑わう。夏期のみ宮之浦川で川下りを楽しめる。美人の湯としても知られる。
review_summary:
Visitors say this onsen offers a relaxing soak in warm, sulfur-scented alkaline spring water, perfect for post-hike recovery. They also highlight the very reasonable 300 yen entry fee and the availability of free lockers.

Other reviews mention the facilities can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along Kusukawa Port. The view from the summit of Mount Miyanoura is spectacular, attracting many climbers. In summer, you can enjoy river rafting on the Miyanoura River. It is also known as a beautiful hot spring.

name: 口之島温泉
location: 鹿児島県 鹿児島郡十島村
sales_point: トカラ列島最北端の口之島に位置する温泉地。施設は2ヶ所で、1ヶ所は役場の出張所がある建物の中にあり、もう1ヶ所は中之島を望む場所で眺望が良い。釣りや海水浴が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located on Kuchinoshima, the northernmost island of the Tokara Islands. There are two facilities; one is inside a building with a branch office of the town hall, and the other offers a great view overlooking Nakinoshima. Fishing and beach activities can be enjoyed.

name: 栗野岳温泉
location: 鹿児島県 姶良郡湧水町
sales_point: 栗野岳西側山麓、標高750メートルに位置する温泉地。5分ほどで八幡大地獄で、冬になると地獄の蒸気が南国に珍しい霧氷を作ることで知られている。飲泉も可。
sales_point_en: Located at the western foothills of Kurino Dake, at an elevation of 750 meters. Known for the steam from the hells of Yahata Daijigoku creating rare frost in the winter. Drinking water is also available.

name: 郡山温泉
location: 鹿児島県 鹿児島市
sales_point: 郡山町に位置する温泉地。山あいの静かな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: A tranquil hot spring area located in Koriyama Town, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 栄之尾（霧島温泉郷）
sales_point: 霧島温泉郷の一角、霧島山の西側山麓にあり、閑静な環境にある。霧島観光の足場にも好適。
sales_point_en: Situated in a quiet environment on the western foothills of Mount Kirishima, this hot spring area is also a great base for Kirishima sightseeing.

name: 坂本温泉
location: 鹿児島県 鹿児島郡三島村
sales_point: 硫黄島の北側に位置する温泉地。温泉からは開聞岳を眺望でき風光明媚な環境にある。湯は潮の干満によって温度が変わる。
sales_point_en: Located on the northern side of Iwo Jima, this hot spring offers scenic views of Kaimondake and a picturesque environment. The water temperature changes with the tides.

name: 薩摩温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩郡さつま町
sales_point: 川内川の支流、夜星川河畔に位置する温泉地。アスレチックジム、プールなどのスポーツ施設が併設されている。リフレッシュでき、家族連れにも好評。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features high-quality, hot spring water with a distinctive sulfur scent and a "torotoro" (thick and smooth) texture that leaves skin feeling soft. They also highlight the incredibly affordable entrance fee and the convenient early morning opening hours. Others also like the traditional, calming atmosphere and the availability of free, spacious parking.
sales_point_en: Located by the riverside of Yoboshi River, this hot spring area features sports facilities such as an athletic gym and a pool. It's refreshing and popular with families.

name: 薩摩温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩郡さつま町
sales_point: 薩摩町の北西部に位置する温泉地。ゴルフ・テニス・プールなどが楽しめる大型のリゾート施設が併設されている。家族連れにも好評。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features high-quality, hot spring water with a distinctive sulfur scent and a "torotoro" (thick and smooth) texture that leaves skin feeling soft. They also highlight the incredibly affordable entrance fee and the convenient early morning opening hours. Others also like the traditional, calming atmosphere and the availability of free, spacious parking.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located in the northwest of Satsuma Town, featuring a large resort facility with golf, tennis, and a pool. It's also popular with families.

name: 里温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩川内市
sales_point: 鹿児島県の西方、曽瓦島列島の北東端に位置する温泉地。眺望が素晴らしく、風光明媚な環境にある。閑静で保養・療養に好適。
review_summary:
Guests consistently praise this inn for its unique, high-quality radon magnetic hot spring, noting its smooth, thick texture, and the delicious seasonal local cuisine. Furthermore, they highlight the attentive staff and appreciate family-friendly amenities such as diaper pails.

Some reviews mention the rooms can be poorly maintained.
sales_point_en: Located on the northeastern tip of the Sogawara Islands, this hot spring area offers stunning views and a picturesque environment. It's quiet and suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: サンピアアイラ温泉
location: 鹿児島県 姶良郡姶良町
sales_point: 錦江湾の奥姶良に位置する温泉地。施設は厚生年金福祉施設となっている。湾の向こうに桜島を望むことができ、眺望が良い。テニスコートやプールもある。
sales_point_en: Situated in the depths of Kinko Bay, this hot spring facility is a welfare facility for employees. It offers great views of Sakurajima across the bay, and has tennis courts and a pool.

name: 紫尾温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩郡さつま町
sales_point: 紫尾山の東側山麓に位置する温泉地。紫尾神社の境内に湧く温泉で、保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features high-quality, hot spring water with a distinctive sulfur scent and a "torotoro" (thick and smooth) texture that leaves skin feeling soft. They also highlight the incredibly affordable entrance fee and the convenient early morning opening hours. Others also like the traditional, calming atmosphere and the availability of free, spacious parking.
sales_point_en: Located on the eastern foothills of Mount Shibō, this hot spring springs from the grounds of Shibō Shrine, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 白木川内温泉
sales_point: 広瀬川の支流、白木川内川の谷間に位置する温泉地。野趣に富む岩風呂が好評。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。
sales_point_en: Nestled in the valley of the Shiroki Kawauchi River, a tributary of the Hirose River, this hot spring is known for its rustic rock baths. It's a quiet environment suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 城山温泉
sales_point: ＪＲ国分駅の東方、城山に位置する温泉地。国分随一の温泉で、高台にあり国分平野を一望できる。閑静な環境にあり、ビジネスや観光に便利。
sales_point_en: Located east of JR Kokubu Station on Shiroyama, this is the premier hot spring in Kokubu, situated on a hill with a panoramic view of the Kokubu Plain. It's in a quiet environment, convenient for business and tourism.

name: 新川（新川渓谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 霧島山麓の新川渓谷に位置する温泉地。閑静な環境にあり、保養・療養に好適。四季折々の渓谷美も有名であり、特に旧ラムネ温泉付近の紅葉は素晴らしい。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located in the Shinkawa Valley at the foothills of Mount Kirishima, this hot spring area is quiet and suitable for relaxation and recuperation. The seasonal beauty of the valley is famous, especially the autumn leaves near the old Ramune Onsen.

name: 新湯（霧島温泉郷）
sales_point: 霧島山の東南側中腹、標高800ﾒｰﾄﾙに位置する温泉地。霧島温泉郷の一角で閑静な環境にある。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: People say this hot spring offers a pure white, milky sulfur spring with strong therapeutic effects and a powerful volcanic aroma. They also highlight the rustic bathhouse vibe, the availability of both hot and lukewarm baths, and the option for day-use. Guests mention the staff are friendly and kind, and the inn provides clean, new rooms with delicious, plentiful meals for overnight stays.
sales_point_en: Situated at an elevation of 800 meters on the southeastern slope of Mount Kirishima, this hot spring area is in a quiet environment and is a national health resort.

name: 諏訪温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩川内市
sales_point: 県立公園の西にある愛宕山の山麓に位置する温泉地。古くから近郊の人々の湯治場として親しまれている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring features excellent, iron-rich, brown-colored water with various bath temperatures, including very hot options and open-air baths. Guests also highlight the clean rooms, good food, and friendly staff.

Some reviews mention the water can be extremely hot.
sales_point_en: Located at the foothills of Mount Atago, west of the prefectural park, this hot spring has been a popular healing spot for locals for many years.

name: 川内市街地温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩川内市
sales_point: 川内駅周辺の市街地に点在する温泉施設の総称。効能も高く地元の人々や観光客に親しまれている。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring resort offers excellent quality sulfur spring water that feels smooth and warm, with some baths featuring impressive designs. They also highlight the affordable prices for the communal baths and the quiet, nostalgic atmosphere that evokes a sense of stepping back in time.
sales_point_en: A collective term for hot spring facilities scattered around the area near Kawauchi Station. Known for its high efficacy, it is popular among locals and tourists.

name: 川内高城温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩川内市
sales_point: 川内市の西部に位置し、周囲を山に囲まれた閑静な温泉地。400年前、外国人宣教師によって発見されたと伝えられる。
sales_point_en: Located in the western part of Satsumasendai City, this quiet hot spring area is surrounded by mountains. It is said to have been discovered by foreign missionaries 400 years ago.

name: 谷山温泉
location: 鹿児島県 鹿児島市
sales_point: 鹿児島市南部、旧谷山市街地に点在する温泉地。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features various functional baths, including bubble baths, reclining baths, and electric baths, along with a sauna and an open-air bath. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the clean, well-maintained facilities.

Other reviews mention the bathing area can be narrow.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area scattered in the southern part of Kagoshima City, in the former Taniyama city center.

name: 種子島温泉
location: 鹿児島県 熊毛郡中種子町
sales_point: 種子島唯一の温泉地。熊野海岸の北側海岸沿いにあり、周囲には亜熱帯植物が繁殖し、南国情緒を満喫できる。種子島観光、ビジネスの拠点に最適。
sales_point_en: The only hot spring on Tanegashima Island, located along the northern coast of Kumano Bay, surrounded by subtropical plants, offering a tropical atmosphere. Ideal as a base for Tanegashima tourism and business.

name: 垂水温泉
sales_point: 錦江湾沿いに臨む垂水港に近い温泉地。正面に開聞岳を望め風光明媚な環境にある。展望浴場からの桜島の夕景は素晴らしい。大隅牛が味わえる。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a unique, rustic bathhouse with mineral-rich, cloudy water that is naturally warm and perfect for long soaks. They also highlight the stunning ocean views, including Kaimondake, and the refreshing cold water bath. Guests mention the affordable 500 yen entry fee and the option to drink the cold well water.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area near Tarumizu Port, facing Kinko Bay. It offers scenic views of Kaimondake and the sunset over Sakurajima from the observation bath. You can also enjoy Osumi beef here.

name: 知覧温泉
location: 鹿児島県 川辺郡知覧町
sales_point: 薩摩の小京都として知られる知覧町に位置する温泉地。古い文化と伝統が今に受け継がれる武家屋敷や世界平和を訴える特攻平和観音堂など見所も多い。
review_summary: Visitors say this museum offers a powerful and moving experience with numerous photos, farewell letters, and personal effects of young special attack force members. They also highlight the valuable insights gained from the 30-minute documentary and the optional audio guide, which enhances understanding of the exhibits. Many mention the affordable 500 yen admission fee and recommend allocating at least two to three hours for a thorough visit.
sales_point_en: Located in Chiran Town, known as the small Kyoto of Satsuma. It features many attractions, including traditional samurai residences and the Peace Kannon Hall advocating world peace.

name: 手洗温泉
sales_point: 霧島山西側山麓、石坂川最上上流付近に位置する温泉地。すぐ上に手洗滝があり、自然環境に恵まれている。
review_summary: People say this hot spring bathhouse offers excellent quality natural hot spring water, including in the showers, and features a small but effective sauna and a mild cold bath. They also highlight the affordable entry fee and the convenient cashless payment options. Guests mention the retro, nostalgic atmosphere and the friendly staff.
sales_point_en: Located at the foot of the western slopes of Mount Kirishima, near the upper reaches of the Ishizaka River. It is blessed with a rich natural environment, with Terai Falls just above.

name: 長島温泉
location: 鹿児島県 出水郡長島町
sales_point: 雲仙天草国立公園の一角に位置する温泉地。眺望の素晴らしい海岸沿いにある。露天風呂から眺める夕陽は格別。日帰り入浴も可。夏は海水浴や観光地引き網が楽しめる。
sales_point_en: Situated in a corner of Unzen-Amakusa National Park, this hot spring area is located along a coastline with stunning views. The sunset viewed from the open-air bath is exceptional. Day-use bathing is also available, and in summer, you can enjoy swimming and sightseeing.

name: 成川温泉
sales_point: 山川港の西岸に位置する温泉地。眺望が良く閑静な環境にある。池田湖、長崎鼻の観光拠点にも好適。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen offers a relaxing experience with hot, clear sulfur spring water that leaves skin feeling smooth. They also highlight the delicious steamed eggs available for purchase and the friendly, helpful staff who adjust the water temperature. Guests mention the reasonable entrance fee and the availability of free parking and lockers.
sales_point_en: Located on the west bank of Yamakawa Port, this hot spring area offers good views and a quiet environment. It is also a suitable base for sightseeing at Lake Ikeda and Nagasaki Nose.

name: 根占温泉
location: 鹿児島県 肝属郡南大隅町
sales_point: 鹿児島県大隅半島の南部に位置する温泉地。霧島屋久国立公園の指定を受け、海・山・川と豊かな自然と史跡に恵まれている。
review_summary:
People say this hot spring facility offers a variety of baths, including a strong saline hot spring, open-air bath, and sauna, leaving skin smooth. Guests also highlight the delicious meals, reasonable prices, and the staff's attentive service.

Other reviews mention there can be a lack of shampoo.
sales_point_en: Located in the southern part of the Osumi Peninsula in Kagoshima Prefecture, this hot spring area is designated as part of Kirishima-Yaku National Park, surrounded by rich nature and historical sites.

name: 野々湯温泉
sales_point: 霧島山西側山麓の山あいに位置する温泉地。えびの高原探勝基地としても便利。付近の散策や、ハイキングなども楽しめる。
review_summary: People say this hot spring inn offers excellent hot springs with natural steam saunas and a wide variety of delicious local dishes, including chicken sashimi and BBQ. They also highlight the reasonable prices for overnight stays and the beautiful views of the surrounding nature. Guests mention the staff are attentive and the atmosphere is rustic and authentic.
sales_point_en: Nestled in the mountains at the foot of the western slopes of Mount Kirishima, this hot spring area is also convenient as a base for exploring Ebino Highlands. Nearby, you can enjoy walking and hiking.

name: 浜平温泉
sales_point: 眼前に錦江湾、右に桜島、左に開聞岳、後方に高隈山山系が映える眺望の素晴らしい温泉地。海水浴や観光客で賑わう。
review_summary: Visitors say this onsen features a unique, rustic bathhouse with mineral-rich, cloudy water that is naturally warm and perfect for long soaks. They also highlight the stunning ocean views, including Kaimondake, and the refreshing cold water bath. Guests mention the affordable 500 yen entry fee and the option to drink the cold well water.
sales_point_en: This hot spring area boasts a stunning view with Kinko Bay in front, Sakurajima to the right, and Kaimondake to the left, with the Takakuma mountain range in the background. It is bustling with beachgoers and tourists.

name: 林田（霧島温泉郷）
sales_point: 霧島山西側山麓、標高780メートルに位置する温泉地。眺望が良い。霧島温泉郷の代表にふさわしく、一度に千人も収容できる大浴場が迎えてくれる。国民保養温泉地。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring destination offers a variety of spring qualities and features a foot bath. They also highlight the delicious steamed eggs and corn, as well as crispy and juicy Kurobuta pork cutlets. Others mention the stunning views from the elevated location and the convenience of souvenir shops and restaurants.
sales_point_en: Located at an elevation of 780 meters on the western slopes of Mount Kirishima, this hot spring area offers great views. It is representative of the Kirishima Onsen area, featuring a large bath that can accommodate up to 1,000 people. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 隼人中部温泉
sales_point: ホテル京セラ内にある温泉。
review_summary: People say this family bath offers spacious and clean private rooms with continuously flowing, fresh hot spring water. They also highlight the affordable prices and the ability to adjust the water temperature to personal preference. Others also like the air-conditioned changing rooms and the convenient early morning operating hours.
sales_point_en: This hot spring is located within Hotel Kyocera.

name: 日当山温泉
sales_point: 隼人町の平野部、天降川下流の両岸に広がる温泉地。1293年開湯という、県内最古の温泉。鹿児島の奥座敷と言われ、西郷隆盛もよく訪れた。美肌効果が高い。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area spreads along both banks of the Amagase River in the plains of Hayato Town. It is the oldest hot spring in the prefecture, established in 1293, and is known as the hidden retreat of Kagoshima, frequently visited by Saigo Takamori. It is renowned for its skin-beautifying effects and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 日之出（新川渓谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 新川渓谷沿いに位置する温泉地。新川渓谷温泉郷のひとつに数えられ、閑静な環境にある。保養に好適。日帰り入浴もできる。国民保養温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located along the Shinkawa Valley, this hot spring area is counted among the Shinkawa Valley Onsen area and is situated in a quiet environment, making it suitable for relaxation. Day-use bathing is also available, and it is designated as a national health resort.

name: 姫城温泉
sales_point: 隼人町と国分市にまたがった姫城地区に位置する温泉地。鹿児島湾でとれる海の幸を堪能することができる。
review_summary: People say this private bathhouse offers a wide variety of clean and well-maintained rooms, with some featuring saunas, cold water tubs, and even slides for children. They also highlight the smooth, skin-beautifying alkaline spring water and the availability of amenities. Guests mention the comfortable and relaxing atmosphere, with many appreciating the option to reserve rooms in advance.
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located in the Himejyo district, straddling Hayato Town and Kokubu City, where you can enjoy fresh seafood from Kagoshima Bay.

name: 吹上温泉
sales_point: 伊作川沿いに位置する温泉地。西郷隆盛も湯治に訪れた歴史の古い温泉。緑の多い閑静な環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。海亀の産卵で有名な吹上浜が近い。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Izaku River, this hot spring area has a long history, having been visited by Saigo Takamori for healing. It is located in a green and quiet environment, making it ideal for relaxation and recuperation. Fukiage Beach, famous for sea turtle nesting, is nearby.

name: 古里温泉
location: 鹿児島県 鹿児島市
sales_point: 桜島の南岸、錦江湾に面して位置する温泉地。海を眺められる露天風呂がある。夜は漁火を望むことができ、眺望に恵まれた温泉地。
sales_point_en: Located on the southern shore of Sakurajima, facing Kinko Bay, this hot spring area features open-air baths with sea views. At night, you can enjoy the sight of fishing lights, making it a hot spring area blessed with beautiful scenery.

name: 星の郷温泉
sales_point: 桜島カントリークラブの西側に位置する温泉地。風光明媚で静かな環境にある。露天風呂や宿からは錦江湾や桜島が一望できる。テニス、クルージング、釣りなど楽しんだ後の海の幸は格別。
sales_point_en: This hot spring area is located west of Sakurajima Country Club, in a picturesque and tranquil environment. From the open-air baths and accommodations, you can enjoy panoramic views of Kinko Bay and Sakurajima. After enjoying activities like tennis, cruising, and fishing, the seafood is exceptional.

name: マグマ温泉
location: 鹿児島県 鹿児島市
sales_point: 鹿児島市内を遠望できる高台に位置する温泉地。鹿児島港からフェリーで約15分とアクセスも良い。湯は飲用でき、貧血症に効果があると言われる。桜島自然恐竜公園まで遊歩道が完備されている。
review_summary:
People say this onsen features a unique, iron-rich, brown, cloudy hot spring with a high mineral content, and offers stunning views of the bay and Kagoshima city. They also highlight the affordable entry fee, the availability of shampoo and body soap, and the convenient location near the ferry terminal.

Some reviews mention the staff can be impolite.
sales_point_en: Situated on a hill with a distant view of Kagoshima City, this hot spring area is easily accessible, just a 15-minute ferry ride from Kagoshima Port. The water is drinkable and is said to be effective for anemia. A walking path is available to Sakurajima Natural Dinosaur Park.

name: 丸尾（霧島温泉郷）
sales_point: 霧島温泉郷の中心的な温泉地。霧島探勝のベースに好適。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring destination offers a variety of spring qualities and features a foot bath. They also highlight the delicious steamed eggs and corn, as well as crispy and juicy Kurobuta pork cutlets. Others mention the stunning views from the elevated location and the convenience of souvenir shops and restaurants.
sales_point_en: This is a central hot spring area in the Kirishima Onsen area, making it a suitable base for exploring Kirishima. It is designated as a national health resort.

name: 宮之城温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩郡さつま町
sales_point: 川内川沿いに位置する温泉地。周囲を丘陵に囲まれ、のどかな環境にある。旧名湯田温泉。孟宗竹の産地として有名な町には、かぐや姫伝説が今も残る。
review_summary: Guests mention this ryokan offers rooms with private open-air baths and a rare free-flowing lukewarm spring, with many highlighting the smooth, skin-softening water quality. They also appreciate the delicious meals, especially the beef dishes, and the attentive staff who provide warm service. Visitors highlight the reasonable prices and the tranquil, hidden-away atmosphere.
sales_point_en: Located along the Sendai River, this hot spring area is surrounded by hills, providing a peaceful environment. Formerly known as Yuda Onsen, the town is famous for its production of Moso bamboo and is steeped in the legend of Princess Kaguya.

name: 宮之城ちくりん温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩郡さつま町
sales_point: 町は全体的に孟宗竹の産地として有名なことから独立国「ちくりん村」を名乗っており、さまざまなイベントなどで賑わっている。
sales_point_en: The town is known for its production of Moso bamboo, and it proudly calls itself the independent country of 'Chikurin Village,' bustling with various events.

name: 妙見（新川渓谷温泉郷）
sales_point: 新川渓谷にある風情のある温泉街で湯治、宿泊客が多い。四季の花に触れ、川では鮎・ハヤ釣りなども楽しむことができる。付近には素朴な観光施設も多い。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。新川渓谷温泉郷の一角で、牧園町と隼人町にまたがって広がっている。
sales_point_en: This charming hot spring town in the Shinkawa Valley is popular among those seeking healing and accommodation. Visitors can enjoy seasonal flowers and fishing for sweetfish and hayas in the river. There are also many rustic tourist facilities nearby. It is designated as a national health resort and is part of the Shinkawa Valley Onsen area, spanning across Makizono Town and Hayato Town.

name: 屋久島温泉
location: 鹿児島県 熊毛郡屋久町
sales_point: 本富岳南西側山麓に位置する温泉地。眺望も良く風光明媚な環境にある。周囲の観光や奥岳へのハイキング基地としても好適。
sales_point_en: Located at the southwestern foot of Mount Bontoku, this hot spring area offers good views and a picturesque environment. It is also a suitable base for sightseeing and hiking in the surrounding area.

name: 山川天然砂むし温泉
sales_point: 伏目海岸沿いに位置する温泉地。天然の砂蒸し温泉からの開聞岳や大隅半島などの眺望が良い。
review_summary: Visitors say this sand bath offers a unique and relaxing experience with warm, heavy sand and the soothing sound of ocean waves. They also highlight the beautiful ocean views and the option to have staff take photos with personal phones for a fee. Guests mention the convenient set tickets that include access to nearby hot springs.
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along the Fushime coastline, offering great views of Mount Kaimon and the Osumi Peninsula from the natural sand baths.

name: 湯川内温泉
sales_point: 紫尾山の北側山麓、三方を山に囲まれた谷あいに位置する温泉地。閑静な環境で保養・療養に好適。
review_summary: People say this hot spring features rare foot-of-the-tub spring water, with clear, emerald-colored, slightly sulfur-scented water that is perfect for long, relaxing soaks. They also highlight the tranquil, rustic atmosphere, enhanced by the sounds of nature. Guests mention the staff are welcoming and provide helpful explanations about the hot spring.
sales_point_en: Nestled in a valley surrounded by mountains on the northern foothills of Mount Shibosan, this hot spring area is ideal for relaxation and recuperation in a tranquil environment.

name: 湯島温泉
location: 鹿児島県 薩摩川内市
sales_point: 川内川河口近くに位置する温泉地。県内では珍しい漢方温泉。近辺の住民の湯治に利用されている。
sales_point_en: Located near the mouth of the Sendai River, this hot spring area features a rare herbal hot spring in the prefecture, often used by local residents for healing.

name: 湯之尾温泉
location: 鹿児島県 伊佐郡菱刈町
sales_point: 川内川沿いに位置する温泉地。日本一の菱刈金山の金鉱床から湧き出ている。静かな環境で保養・静養にもよい。
sales_point_en: Situated along the Sendai River, this hot spring area springs from the gold deposits of the famous Hishikari Gold Mine, providing a peaceful environment suitable for relaxation and recuperation.

name: 湯之谷（霧島温泉郷）
sales_point: 霧島温泉郷の一角。湯之谷川沿いの山峡に位置する温泉地。国民保養温泉地に指定されている。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring features excellent, continuously flowing spring water with abundant "yunohana" (mineral deposits), offering distinct sulfur and carbonated springs, as well as a mixed-temperature option. They also highlight the delicious, locally inspired meals and the attentive, kind staff. Guests mention the well-maintained facilities, including clean rooms and restrooms, and appreciate the convenient on-site drinking water spring.
sales_point_en: Part of the Kirishima Onsen area, this hot spring is located in a mountain gorge along the Yunotani River and is designated as a national health resort.

name: 湯之野温泉
sales_point: 高千穂峰や中岳の登山口「高千穂河原」へ約4キロの所に位置する温泉地。霧島連山への登山拠点に好適。
sales_point_en: Located about 4 kilometers from the trailhead 'Takachiho-gawara' for climbing Mount Takachiho and Nakadake, this hot spring is a great base for hiking in the Kirishima mountain range.

name: 湯之元温泉
sales_point: 海亀の産卵で有名な吹上浜の北側に位置する温泉地。300年の歴史を持つ古湯。近隣には薩摩焼きの窯元が多い。
review_summary: Visitors say this hot spring offers a tranquil atmosphere with beautiful garden views, and features both a main bath and a unique steam sauna that uses natural hot spring water. They also highlight the complimentary coffee and cold water available in the relaxing rest area. Guests mention the reasonable 600 yen admission fee and the provision of amenities like shampoo, conditioner, and body soap.
sales_point_en: This hot spring area, with a history of 300 years, is located north of Buki Beach, famous for sea turtle nesting. Many pottery kilns of Satsuma ware are nearby.

name: 吉田温泉
location: 鹿児島県 鹿児島市
sales_point: 川沿いに位置する温泉地。三方を山に囲まれ、静かな環境にある。ICから1分と車でのアクセスに便利。
sales_point_en: A hot spring area located along a river, surrounded by mountains, providing a quiet environment. Convenient access by car, just one minute from the interchange.

name: 吉松温泉
location: 鹿児島県 姶良郡湧水町
sales_point: 川内川の西岸沿いに位置する温泉地。農村地帯ののどかな環境にあり、保養・休養に好適。
sales_point_en: Situated along the west bank of the Sendai River, this hot spring area is in a peaceful rural setting, ideal for relaxation and recuperation.
